jobs.description:
Build our future together:

The Neurology Account Director (NAD) is a field-based institutional key account role responsible for driving the launch and ongoing commercial performance of Regeneron's C5 inhibitor for generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) within approximately 10 - 12 assigned academic medical centers (AMCs) infusion centers, and neuromuscular specialty centers. The account director serves as a Regeneron commercial point of contact within targeted institutions, responsible for formulary access, infusion suite education and pull-through, and long-term institutional partnership development. The AD combines deep MG clinical acumen, institutional navigation skills, financial acumen, and cross-functional coordination to maximize patient access and revenue within their assigned territory.

When & where:

  • Remote role

  • Location: South Central (Texas, Arkansas and Louisiana)

  • Travel: Up to 60–70%, including overnight travel within assigned territory

Discover your role:

Institutional Account Management

  • Own and manage a portfolio of approximately 10 -12 AMCs and neuromuscular specialty centers within an assigned U.S. region, serving as the institutional commercial lead.

  • Develop and execute comprehensive account plans for each institution, including formulary strategy, stakeholder mapping, competitive positioning, and patient access pathways.

  • Navigate complex institutional buying environments including P&T committees, pharmacy contracting, hospital administration, and infusion center operations.

  • Build and maintain deep, trust-based relationships with neurology department heads, treating neurologists, clinical pharmacists, infusion nurses, and medical directors.

Formulary & Market Access Pull-Through

  • Lead formulary and pathway submissions and P&T committee presentations at targeted institutions, positioning the C5 inhibitor for preferred or unrestricted formulary status.

  • Partner with Market Access National and Payer Account Directors to align institutional contracting with broader payer strategy and resolve prior authorization barriers.

  • Coordinate with specialty pharmacy partners and Patient Services hub to ensure seamless reimbursement workflows for buy-and-bill infusion products.

  • Track formulary status, pull-through metrics, and access barriers across all assigned accounts; escalate systemic issues with data-driven recommendations.

Stakeholder & KOL Engagement

  • Identify, develop, and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs) in neuromuscular medicine within assigned territory, in coordination with Medical Affairs.

  • Represent Regeneron at national and regional neurology congresses (AAN, MGFA), medical education events, and institutional grand rounds as appropriate.

Analytics, Planning & Reporting

  • Maintain detailed CRM records and account intelligence; leverage IQVIA/Symphony Health data for prescriber-level targeting and performance measurement.

  • Track and report on KPIs including accounts engaged, formulary inclusions achieved, patient switches, revenue per account, and competitive share of voice.

  • Prepare and present quarterly business reviews to the Executive Director, highlighting account progress, barriers, competitive dynamics, and resource needs.

  • Contribute to territory realignment recommendations and Year 2 expansion planning based on field-level market intelligence.

This role requires:

  • Bachelor's degree required; PharmD, RN, or advanced degree in life sciences strongly preferred.

  • Minimum 10-12+ years institutional sales, market access, or account management experience inpharmaceutical/biotech.

  • Demonstrated experience with hospital/AMC formulary processes, P&T committee engagement, and institutional buy-and-bill contracting.

  • Track record of success in rare disease, neurology, or specialty biologic sales/account management, ideally including launch experience.

  • Strong clinical acumen with the ability to engage physicians, pharmacists, and medical directors in scientifically rigorous conversations.

  • Experience executing competitive switch or conversion strategies in institutional settings.

  • Proficiency with CRM systems and commercial analytics platforms (IQVIA, Symphony Health, specialty pharmacy data).

  • Ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder account relationships independently with minimal supervision.

  • Willingness to travel 60–70% within assigned territory, including overnight travel.

  • Candidates must reside within the assigned territory.

Preferred:

  • Experience in complement biology, neuromuscular disease, or C5/FcRn inhibitor markets.

  • Existing relationships with neurology KOLs or MGFA-recognized center-of-excellence leadership.

  • Prior experience with infusion biologic launches in hospital/outpatient infusion settings.

  • Knowledge of specialty pharmacy hub operations, patient assistance programs, and prior authorization workflows.

  • Understanding of medical benefit (Part B) reimbursement, ASP pricing dynamics, and buy-and-bill economics.

Core Competencies:

  • Clinical Credibility – Translates C5 mechanism of action, dosing differentiation, and clinical evidence into compelling value propositions that resonate with treating physicians and institutional decision-makers.

  • Institutional Account Navigation – Expertly engages across all levels of AMC hierarchies, from neurology fellows to C-suite administrators, pharmacy directors to infusion center leadership.

  • Strategic Account Planning – Builds data-driven, multi-quarter account strategies that address formulary access, competitive positioning, and patient journey barriers.

  • Patient Journey Management – Coordinates cross-functionally with Patient Services, specialty pharmacy, and market access to remove barriers and ensure seamless treatment initiation and continuation.

  • Relationship Building – Develops deep, trust-based institutional partnerships that create long-term competitive advantages in rare neuromuscular disease.

  • Results Orientation – Drives measurable outcomes through disciplined account planning, KPI tracking, and relentless follow-through on formulary wins.

Job Title: Oracle Cloud Solution ArchitectJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: NoneEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking an Oracle Cloud Solution Architect to design and deliver the integration and data conversion solution for a major federal HCM modernization program migrating legacy HR systems to Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM.

Working under the Program Technical Lead, you will convert technical strategy into detailed solution architecture and oversee the development team that builds, tests, and deploys the solution. This is a hands‑on technical delivery role: the functional team owns HR policy and module configuration, while you own the technical design and construction of integrations, conversions, and supporting cloud platform components. The ideal candidate has extensive Oracle Cloud implementation experience and a track record of delivering complex solutions to production.

Responsibilities:

  • Translate the technical strategy and implementation plans provided by the Program Technical Lead into detailed solution designs for integration and data conversion.

  • Design, build, and deploy integrations between Oracle Fusion Cloud and federal systems (EHRI, eOPF, USA Staffing, payroll providers) using Oracle Integration Cloud and web services.

  • Own the end‑to‑end legacy‑to‑Fusion data conversion lifecycle, including mapping, loading, validation, reconciliation, and managing mock conversions through cutover.

  • Direct technical developers, assigning work, removing blockers, reviewing deliverables, and ensuring adherence to standards and design specifications.

  • Perform complex development activities including SQL, PL/SQL, interface components, and advanced data extraction logic.

  • Provision and administer OCI/PaaS environments—including OIC, ATP, VBCS, and APEX—and manage compartments, users, IAM policies, and platform resources.

  • Partner with functional leads to convert approved configurations and HR policy requirements into technical design and field‑level mappings; identify and escalate data model constraints.

  • Ensure all technical components meet FedRAMP, agency security, and ATO compliance requirements.

  • Track progress, risks, and technical issues for the workstream; recommend solutions and report status to the Program Technical Lead.

  • Provide technical estimates and solution input for change requests and task orders.

  • Execute system integration testing, support UAT, run mock conversions, and lead cutover activities; confirm technical readiness at each milestone.

  • Author and maintain technical design documents, interface specifications, conversion plans, and environment architecture documentation.


Qualifications:

Required:

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen and able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

  • Bachelor’s degree and 10+ years of relevant experience (additional experience may substitute for degree).

  • 10+ years architecting and delivering Oracle ERP or Oracle Cloud solutions, including multiple full lifecycle Oracle Cloud implementations.

  • Proven record of delivering Oracle Cloud implementations to production as the accountable solution architect.

  • Strong command of the Oracle Cloud data model and ability to design integrations, extracts, and conversions even in unfamiliar schemas.

  • Advanced SQL and PL/SQL development skills.

  • Hands‑on experience with Oracle PaaS (OIC, ATP, VBCS, APEX).

  • Experience leading data conversion efforts including mapping, load, validation, and reconciliation.

  • Hands‑on OCI administration experience (compartments, IAM policies, instance provisioning).

  • Experience directing technical development teams.

  • Prior delivery on U.S. federal programs, including familiarity with FedRAMP and federal security requirements.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Desired:

  • Oracle Cloud certifications in Integration, OCI, or Autonomous Database.

  • PMP certification.

  • Master’s degree in a related technical field.

  • Experience with Oracle HCM tools (HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, Security Console).

  • Experience with federal HR data exchanges (EHRI, eOPF, USA Staffing).

  • Experience with Oracle EBS Federal HR/Financials and EBS‑to‑Fusion migration.

  • Agile certification (SAFe Agilist or equivalent).

  • Prior experience supporting federal civilian or DoD programs.

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.

This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$114,600-$252,100

  • Draws actionable quality-related conclusions and recommends performance improvement initiatives.
  • Ensures compliance with all quality-related regulatory audit guidelines by adhering to roadmap of deliverables and timelines, and implements solutions to maximize national Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) audit success.
  • Partners with cross-functional teams to ensure data quality delivery through sequential transformations, draws actionable conclusions, and identifies opportunities to close quality care gaps.
  • Ensures that program deliverables meet all quality standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Creates and reviews quality-related program documentation, including plans, reports, and records, ensuring deliverables meet quality standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Provides advanced subject matter support within the quality team; maintains flexibility to pivot and support other requests as needed.
  • Provides informal guidance and knowledge sharing to team members related to assigned quality initiatives and processes.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 4 years of program/project management experience in quality, including experience supporting HEDIS activities targeting and reporting, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • Health care experience and functional quality knowledge.
  • Familiarity with running queries in Microsoft Azure or Structured Query Language (SQL) server.
  • Intellectual agility and ability to simplify and clearly communicate complex concepts.
  • Proficiency with data analysis, manipulation, interpretation, and reporting.
  • Strong quantitative aptitude, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work cross-collaboratively in a highly matrixed organization.
  • Effective verbal, written and presentation communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Intermediate knowledge/experience related to National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA), Healthcare Effectiveness Data Information Set (HEDIS), Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), and state-specific regulatory submission requirements.

  • Knowledge of health care claim elements: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT), CPT Category II (CPTII), Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC), Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine – Clinical Terms (SNOMED), Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPS), National Drug Code (NDC), CVX Codes (CVX), National Provider Identifiers (NPIs), Taxpayer Identification Numbers (TINs), etc.
  • Experience working in a cross-functional, highly matrixed organization, preferably within a managed care organization supporting Medicaid, Medicare, and/or Marketplace programs.

Description

TripleTen is a career learning platform for people in a world being reshaped by AI. We help people learn the tech and AI skills to move into higher-paying roles and keep up as the economy shifts. Established in 2019, we are part of Nebius Group, a global leader in AI infrastructure. We work remotely across the US, Europe, LatAm, and beyond.

About the role

﻿

Our brand and marketing team ships a lot with few people across several zones, and the small work has outgrown us: pages to update, articles to republish, tickets going stale, finished work nobody can find. This role picks that up and puts a system under it. The biggest recurring piece is the blog. Search engines were happy to leave a good article alone for a year; AI assistants are not, so everything we publish gets refreshed regularly.

You’ll report to our Brand Director and work closely with a strong team of brand, organic and social media marketers, designers, and copywriter.

What you will do

  • Blog refresh: Work closely with our SEO/GEO Growth Engineer to update roughly 10-20 published articles a month with Claude. Update facts, tighten structure, put finished text live and check if its formatting, links, images, and copy landed well.
  • Small page edits: Minor changes on live pages—a date, a price, a link. Our Claude agents know where the components live, but they need you to tell what to change.
  • Coordination: Chase the pieces an article needs before it ships: a student quote, a cover brief, a fresh instructor photo; ping a vendor for a lost invoice, get it and upload into our internal billing system.
  • The records: Keep the change log and team’s Jira board current.
  • The system: help us identify repeatable tasks and their cadence to initiate automations and then keep them running.

Requirements

  • Hands-on work with Claude or similar: You've used one on real work, and you know where it gets things wrong.
  • Junior project-management skill: You carry a batch of small tasks at once and close them without being chased. You'd rather build a system than keep remembering.
  • A careful eye: You catch a wrong number, a dead link, a changed heading.
  • B2+ English: Strong enough to spot AI patterns in published copy and hear when a sentence stops sounding natural.
  • Comfortable in a repo and a tracker: we use GitHub + Claude Code, WordPress, Jira, Figma, Notion. If you’re not familiar with them, be prepared to pick up quickly.

Nice to have:

  • Basic marketing understanding: enough context to see why a page, an article, or a funnel exists, how they get found, and question links with no UTMs.

What we can offer you

  • Full onboarding into our AI-first stack and our brand kit.
  • A close-knit global team across the US, Europe, and LatAm.

jobs.description:
Description

TripleTen is a career learning platform for people in a world being reshaped by AI. We help people learn the tech and AI skills to move into higher-paying roles and keep up as the economy shifts. Established in 2019, we are part of Nebius Group, a global leader in AI infrastructure. We work remotely across the US, Europe, LatAm, and beyond.

About the role

﻿

Our brand and marketing team ships a lot with few people across several zones, and the small work has outgrown us: pages to update, articles to republish, tickets going stale, finished work nobody can find. This role picks that up and puts a system under it. The biggest recurring piece is the blog. Search engines were happy to leave a good article alone for a year; AI assistants are not, so everything we publish gets refreshed regularly.

You’ll report to our Brand Director and work closely with a strong team of brand, organic and social media marketers, designers, and copywriter.

What you will do

  • Blog refresh: Work closely with our SEO/GEO Growth Engineer to update roughly 10-20 published articles a month with Claude. Update facts, tighten structure, put finished text live and check if its formatting, links, images, and copy landed well.
  • Small page edits: Minor changes on live pages—a date, a price, a link. Our Claude agents know where the components live, but they need you to tell what to change.
  • Coordination: Chase the pieces an article needs before it ships: a student quote, a cover brief, a fresh instructor photo; ping a vendor for a lost invoice, get it and upload into our internal billing system.
  • The records: Keep the change log and team’s Jira board current.
  • The system: help us identify repeatable tasks and their cadence to initiate automations and then keep them running.

Requirements

  • Hands-on work with Claude or similar: You've used one on real work, and you know where it gets things wrong.
  • Junior project-management skill: You carry a batch of small tasks at once and close them without being chased. You'd rather build a system than keep remembering.
  • A careful eye: You catch a wrong number, a dead link, a changed heading.
  • B2+ English: Strong enough to spot AI patterns in published copy and hear when a sentence stops sounding natural.
  • Comfortable in a repo and a tracker: we use GitHub + Claude Code, WordPress, Jira, Figma, Notion. If you’re not familiar with them, be prepared to pick up quickly.

Nice to have:

  • Basic marketing understanding: enough context to see why a page, an article, or a funnel exists, how they get found, and question links with no UTMs.
  • Experience keeping a team's tickets, files, or documentation in order.

What we can offer you

  • Remote, part-time collaboration (about 20 hours per week).
  • Room to grow into more hours, full-time and a wider role in brand, marketing, or production.
  • Full onboarding into our AI-first stack and our brand kit.
  • A close-knit global team across the US, Europe, and LatAm.

With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

Jabil is a product solutions company providing comprehensive design, manufacturing, supply chain and product management services. Operating from over 100 facilities in 29 countries, Jabil delivers innovative, integrated, and tailored solutions to customers across a broad range of industries and end-markets, such as automotive, consumer lifestyle and wearable tech, defense, and aerospace, connected home and building, industrial and energy, enterprise and infrastructure, healthcare, mobility, packaging and printing.

How will you make an impact?

  • Jabil is seeking a Sr Technical Program Manager, Cloud and Infrastructure who will directly contribute to the transformative growth within our Global cloud Test Development (GCTD) team in the Cloud Enterprise and Infrastructure (CE&I) division by applying unique and innovative approaches to solving problems within a large-scale production environment.

  • As a Sr Technical Program Manager, Cloud and Infrastructure at GCTD, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary manufacturing test projects from start to finish.

  • You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company.

  • You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in manufacturing test development with engineers.

  • You will also be responsible for interfacing with internal engineering, manufacturing and quality teams and our end customers to ensure the project deliverables meet the rigorous standards of Jabil’s world-class manufacturing environments.

  • The Technical Program Manager will facilitate and lead test initiatives for a defined customer (internal or external) or user.

  • Provide full accountability for project schedules, project management, and performance requirements for infrastructure, test development and Framework level projects.

What will you do?

Primary responsibilities of the Technical Program Manager include:

Requirements Management & Planning

  • Ensure all NPI test project requirements are accurately captured, validated, and translated into actionable plans.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to clarify objectives, technical specifications, and deliverables for Infrastructure, SUT, RUT, and GCTD projects.

  • Develop comprehensive project plans, including scope, timelines, resource allocation, and risk mitigation strategies.

Project Execution & Delivery

  • Drive NPI test project tasks to completion, ensuring adherence to schedules, quality standards, and scope.

  • Coordinate Infrastructure NRE planning, material procurement with third-party suppliers, and implementation activities.

  • Partner with factory teams to ensure readiness for new product introduction and smooth transition to production.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary liaison between internal and external customers throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Facilitate end-to-end engagement—from initial requirements gathering to factory acceptance—ensuring alignment and satisfaction.

  • Communicate effectively across diverse audiences, tailoring updates for technical teams, management, and customers.

Monitoring & Reporting

  • Review and validate project schedules with functional managers and cross-functional teams.

  • Track milestones against performance baselines, identifying variances and implementing corrective actions.

  • Provide clear, concise status reports, highlighting issues, resolutions, and overall project health.

Technical Issue Management

  • Triage technical bugs and feature requests in collaboration with engineering teams.

  • Prioritize issues based on impact, allocate resources, and monitor resolution progress.

Resource & Capacity Management

  • Manage GCTD test resource capacity and time tracking for all NPI projects.

  • Optimize resource utilization to meet project demands while maintaining efficiency.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Ensure overall project success, including schedule adherence, quality assurance, and scope control.

  • Promote knowledge sharing and best practices across the test department and global facilities.

  • Mentor and coach team members, fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation.

  • Drive process improvements to enhance project delivery and operational excellence.

Communication & Governance

  • Deliver clear and consistent project updates to stakeholders at all levels.

  • Ensure compliance with organizational standards, policies, and governance frameworks.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Participate in strategic planning and contribute to departmental initiatives.

  • Perform other duties as assigned to support organizational goals.

  • Reports to Management.

How will you get here?

  • Knowledge of Jabil operating policies and procedures required.

  • Expert knowledge of Jabil’s culture and guiding principles

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.

  • Must be adept at navigating the diversified landscape with respect to country cultures, company divisions and internal hierarchies.

  • Responsible for collaborating with employees in all Jabil facilities and job roles to achieve the desired results.

  • Proficiency in use of personal computers, Microsoft Office products (Project, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint) and e-mail skills required.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

Experience:

  • Minimum ten (10) years work-related experience required in project management or related discipline. Or an equivalent combination of education, training and/or experience.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Experience working in a multi-site and multi-cultural environments.

  • Domestic and/or international travel, up to 25-30% required.

What Can Jabil Offer You?

Along with growth, stability, and the opportunity to be challenged, Jabil offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug, and Vision Insurance with HRA and HSA options

  • 401K Match

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Paid Time Off

  • Tuition Reimbursement

  • Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance

  • Commuter Benefits

  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Pet Insurance

  • Adoption Assistance

  • Annual Merit Increases

  • Community Volunteer Opportunities

The pay range for this role is $126,100 - $227,000. These include medical, dental, and vision insurance plans; paid time off accruing at a rate of 3.07 hours during your first year of employment; 4 weeks of paid parental leave; in 2027, 11 company-paid holidays (9 fixed holidays and 2 optional floating holidays), subject to change yearly; 401(k) retirement plan; and employee stock purchase plan.BE AWARE OF FRAUD: When applying for a job at Jabil you will be contacted via correspondence through our official job portal with a jabil.com e-mail address; direct phone call from a member of the Jabil team; or direct e-mail with a jabil.com e-mail address. Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking an experienced Technical Lead to guide the design, development, and delivery of an enterprise-scale, accessible digital platform for a federal government client. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with day-to-day client engagement, driving architecture decisions across WordPress, Drupal, and Salesforce, and API implementations that support these and other business functions, while mentoring a cross-functional delivery team.

You will work closely with the Project Manager, product owners, designers, and fellow engineers to mature and modernize the platform, ensuring every release meets rigorous accessibility, security, and performance standards. In close collaboration with the Project Manager, you will lead and engage the client – bringing technical judgement, translating complex technical tradeoffs into clear, confident conversations that build trust and keep delivery on track.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss or demonstrate relevant project experience during the interview process.You will have the opportunity to join a project that directly supports Bixal’s mission of improving how government serves people.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

This is a full-time role with a salary range of $135,000 – $155,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership

  • Lead architecture and implementation decisions across WordPress, Drupal, and Salesforce, along with API design and integration work connecting these systems.

  • Guide the team in maturing legacy and evolving platforms into modern, enterprise-grade, scalable systems.

  • Set and enforce coding standards, review architecture and code, and drive continuous improvement of technical practices.

  • Ensure development and design work meets accessibility standards (Section 508, WCAG 2.1) across the platform.

  • Partner with DevSecOps and infrastructure teams to maintain secure, reliable, well-documented systems.

Client & Stakeholder Communication

  • Supporting the Project Manager as the technical point of contact, communicating complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Build and maintain trusted, collaborative relationships with client stakeholders, project sponsors, and cross-functional partners.

  • Lead release planning and prioritization by listening to stakeholder input, bringing a clear vision for the solution, and guiding the team toward scope, sequence, and tradeoffs that move the platform forward.

  • Represent the team in client meetings, technical reviews, and planning sessions with polish and confidence, proactively surfacing risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to keep the client informed and engaged.

  • Demonstrated ability to build genuine rapport with clients and stakeholders, remaining calm, positive, and collaborative under pressure.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide day-to-day technical leadership and mentorship to a cross-functional team of engineers and designers.

  • Foster a collaborative, high-performing team culture grounded in accountability and continuous learning.

  • Guide the team through iterative delivery.

Delivery & Quality

  • Develop the technical roadmap collaboratively with the Project Manager, and contribute to its presentation in client and planning sessions.

  • Drive quality through code reviews, automated testing, and adherence to secure development practices.

  • Identify and resolve technical risks, bottlenecks, and technical debt before they impact delivery.

  • Support other technical and delivery activities as needed to keep the platform on track.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree plus at least five (5) years of relevant professional experience in software development or technical leadership; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • At least five (5) years leading or performing on contracts/projects of similar size, scope, and complexity.

  • Experience migrating or consolidating content management platforms, including hands-on work with WordPress and Drupal - theming, custom module/plugin development, and content architecture.

  • Proven experience designing, building, and integrating RESTful APIs across multiple systems and platforms.

  • Experience evaluating and integrating third-party plugins, extensions, and commercial solutions to extend platform capabilities, with sound judgement about when an existing tool meets the need versus when custom development is warranted

  • Demonstrated experience working within enterprise environments and maturing or modernizing existing platforms.

  • Strong understanding of accessible development and design practices (Section 508, WCAG 2.1).

  • Proven track record leading technical teams, with strong mentorship and team-building skills.

  • Polished, confident communication skills, with demonstrated experience presenting to and building relationships with clients and executive stakeholders.

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

    This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience developing for federal government clients or in a federal consulting environment.

  • Experience with Salesforce, including configuration, customization, and integration with external systems.

  • Cloud platform (AWS, Azure,) certifications.

  • Experience with DevSecOps practices in compliance-driven environments.

  • Knowledge of FISMA, FedRAMP, or other federal security frameworks.

  • Experience with content management system migrations or platform modernization efforts.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

About Chainlink
Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi.

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at .

Reporting to the Head of Total Rewards, you will lead compensation programs across offers, promotions, compensation cycles, market pricing, and salary structures, ensuring our decisions are data-backed, defensible, and easy for managers and team members to understand.

This is a hands-on builder role for someone who can move seamlessly between strategy, analytics, and execution. You will partner closely with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, People Ops & Tech, LTI Operations, Finance, and Legal to evolve our compensation function from execution-focused to increasingly recommendation-led.

Your impact

  • Own the execution and evolution of broad-based compensation programs, including offers, promotions, compensation cycles, market pricing, and salary structures.

  • Lead global initiatives across pay equity, job architecture, workforce planning, and compensation program design.

  • Build compensation models, dashboards, and analyses that inform business and People decisions.

  • Lead benchmarking, survey participation, job matching, market pricing, and pay competitiveness analysis.

  • Review complex offers and compensation escalations across levels, functions, and global markets, providing clear recommendations

  • Partner with People Tech on our migration to Pave and the continued development of our compensation data infrastructure.

  • Design clear, accessible compensation views and resources for managers, team members, and People Partners.

  • Advise People Partners and business leaders on compensation strategy, programs, and individual decisions.

  • Translate complex compensation data and trade-offs into concise, executive-ready recommendations.

  • Use AI and modern tooling to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of compensation analysis, reporting, and communication.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of broad-based compensation experience within a fast-paced, global organization; 10+ years for consideration at the senior level.

  • Proven experience owning compensation programs across offers, promotions, compensation cycles, market pricing, and salary structures.

  • Strong compensation benchmarking and market-pricing expertise, including experience with major compensation surveys and datasets.

  • Advanced Google Sheets or Excel modelling and analytical skills; experience working with structured data is highly valued.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to turn complex compensation questions into clear options and recommendations.

  • Experience advising People Partners and senior business leaders on compensation decisions.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and build scalable processes in a rapidly evolving environment.

  • Comfortable partnering cross-functionally with teams such as People Operations, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Legal, and HRIS/People Tech.

  • A builder mindset with an interest in using data, automation, and AI to improve how compensation work gets done.

Preferred requirements

  • Experience with Pave, Workday, SQL/BigQuery, and/or benchmarking platforms such as Radford or Mercer.

  • Experience in high-growth technology, fintech, crypto, or AI environments, with exposure to equity/LTI programs, pay transparency, or job architecture.

All roles with Chainlink Labs are global and remote-based. Unless otherwise stated, we ask that you try to overlap some working hours with Eastern Standard Time (EST).

The Commercial GTM Sales Representative acts as the high-velocity orchestration engine for the closing half of the commercial roofing sales cycle. Operating at a geographical Area Manager level, this role functions as a strategic, data-driven partner to the field, turning qualified intelligence into coordinated action.Upon formal hand-off from the GTM Sales Analyst and entry into Salesforce, the GTM Sales Rep takes full operational command of the project lifecycle. Shifting focus away from early-stage prospecting, this role centers entirely on the critical deal-execution phase.

Job Summary
As the primary driver for late-stage success, you will oversee the complex flow of inbound project demands and steer field representatives toward high-priority targets. By orchestrating bid meetings and performing rigorous win/loss analytics, you provide the vital market intelligence needed to accelerate regional revenue and identify key growth opportunities in emerging strategy markets.

Essential Duties
  • Handoff Orchestration & Nurture Cadence • Formally take ownership of projects and qualified leads once they are logged in Salesforce by the GTM Sales Analyst, initiating a tight, collaborative strategy with field reps. • Actively monitor the area funnel to identify "stuck" projects. Work directly with field reps to provide the necessary technical data, submittals, or incentives to nudge the contractor or owner to a "yes." • Turn top-funnel data into precise field execution, maintaining a rigorous follow-up cadence so multi-month construction timelines are never missed.

jobs.description:
Als Sales Development Representative (SDR) Deutschland spielst du eine Schlüsselrolle in unserem Wachstum. Du öffnest Türen, knüpfst erste Kontakte und sorgst für hochwertige Leads, mit denen wir unseren Marktanteil in Deutschland weiter ausbauen.

Was wirst du machen?

  • Fokus auf Online Sales in Deutschland (und ggf. anderen DACH-Ländern).

  • Erstkontakt mit potenziellen Kunden – inbound und outbound.

  • Qualifizierung von Kundenbedürfnissen und Geschäftschancen.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Solution Experts – sie schließen Deals, die du vorbereitet hast. Natürlich kannst du auch selbst closen!

  • Positiv und fokussiert bleiben, auch wenn du mal ein „Nein“ hörst – ein echter Kämpfer eben.

Svens Tipp für neue 12Builders:

“Seinen eigenen Stil zu finden und damit die Kollegen zu inspirieren, wird ausdrücklich gefördert!”

Wer ist 12Build?

12Build in Kürze: Mit einer großen Portion an Drive, Happiness und Openness bauen wir an einer transparenten Baubranche. Wir sind die SaaS-Plattform, die Bauunternehmen miteinander verbindet und so die Zusammenarbeit fördert. Seit fast zwanzig Jahren gibt es uns bereits – und wir wachsen weiter. Inzwischen sind wir über 90 Kolleginnen und Kollegen, verteilt auf zwei Standorte (Nijverdal und Zwolle). Ein großer Teil der Bauwelt in den Niederlanden, Belgien, Deutschland und Dänemark arbeitet bereits auf unserer Plattform und nutzt unsere Software täglich. Und wir haben die Ambition, ganz Europa zu erobern.

Requirements

Was erwarten wir von dir?

  • Leidenschaft für Sales und den starken Willen, dich weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du sprichst und schreibst perfektes Deutsch – das ist ein Muss.

  • Neugierig, ehrgeizig und ein Teamplayer mit Hands-on-Mentalität.

  • Gute Selbstorganisation, Fokus und Verlässlichkeit.

  • Spaß daran, neue Ideen für Online Sales einzubringen.

Was bieten wir dir?

  • Einen modernen Arbeitsplatz mit allen Tools, um deinen Job wie ein Profi zu machen.

  • Einen Relaxbereich mit Billardtischen, Tischtennis und FIFA 🎮.

  • Laptop.

  • Eine offene und transparente Unternehmenskultur, in der du wirklich gehört wirst.

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events, Workshops und spannende Aktivitäten.

  • Die Möglichkeit, über Compassion ein Patenkind in der Dominikanischen Republik zu unterstützen.

  • Ein Umfeld, in dem Kreativität und Out-of-the-box-Denken geschätzt werden – und in dem deine Ideen sofort Wirkung haben.

  • Keine starren Hierarchien – sondern eine flache Organisation mit kurzen Wegen.

Du hast dir die Mühe gemacht, den Text bis zum Ende zu lesen – das sagt schon alles, oder? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!

Noch Fragen oder ein bisschen unsicher? Kein Problem! Schick gerne eine E-Mail an Niels (Recruiter, ).

Oder schau doch schon mal hinter die Kulissen auf unserem niederländischen 🫢 Instagram oder TikTok.

jobs.title: Senior Product Specialist, ePCR & Fire Software - Digitech - Remote
jobs.excerpt: The Sarnova Family of companies includes Digitech Computer, Bound Tree Medical, Tri-anim Health Services and Cardio Partners.
jobs.description:
The Sarnova Family of companies includes Digitech Computer, Bound Tree Medical, Tri-anim Health Services and Cardio Partners.

Digitech is a leading provider of advanced billing and technology services to the EMS transport industry. Since its founding in 1984, Digitech has refined its software platform to create a cloud-based billing and business intelligence solution that monitors and automates the entire EMS revenue lifecycle. Digitech leverages its proprietary technology to offer fully outsourced services that maximize collections, protect compliance, and deliver results for clients.

Summary:

The Senior Product Specialist supports the ongoing development, enhancement, and delivery of Digitech's ePCR and Fire software solutions. This role serves as a key operational partner to Product Management, Development, QA, and Support teams by maintaining product documentation, coordinating release readiness activities, tracking deliverables, and ensuring customer-facing communications remain accurate and current.

The Senior Product Specialist is responsible for translating complex product functionality into clear documentation, release notes, training materials, and educational content. The role helps maintain alignment across teams throughout the software development lifecycle while supporting product adoption through knowledge management, customer documentation, and training resources.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and update product requirements, feature documentation, and functional specifications
  • Attend product planning, development, and cross-functional meetings while documenting key decisions, action items, and requirements changes
  • Create and maintain customer-facing product documentation, user guides, and knowledge base content
  • Draft, edit, and publish release notes for software enhancements and product updates
  • Develop, script, record, and maintain software training videos and learning materials
  • Manage and organize customer training libraries and educational resources
  • Track product release milestones, deliverables, and dependencies across Product, Development, QA, and Support teams
  • Assist with release readiness planning and cross-functional coordination
  • Monitor documentation updates associated with new releases and product enhancements
  • Coordinate internal and external release communications
  • Partner with Product Owners to maintain current and accurate product requirements documentation
  • Support testing efforts by validating documented functionality and acceptance criteria
  • Ensure consistency and quality across all customer-facing product communications
  • Identify process improvements to improve product documentation, release management, and training effectiveness
  • Assist with special projects supporting product management and customer enablement initiatives
  • Perform additional related duties as assigned

Skills/Experience Required:

  • Education: High School Diploma required; Bachelor’s Degree preferred
  • 3+ years of experience in product operations, product support, technical writing, software documentation, training development, or related field
  • Exceptional written communication and organizational skills
  • Experience creating technical documentation and customer-facing materials
  • Strong project coordination and follow-through skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced software environment
  • Experience with documentation management platforms and collaboration tools
  • Experience with video creation, screen recording, and editing software such as Camtasia, Loom, or similar preferred
  • Experience supporting SaaS or software product organizations preferred
  • Experience using or administering ePCR or Fire software solutions preferred
  • Minimal travel required

Sarnova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We offer a competitive salary, commensurate with experience, along with a comprehensive benefits package, including 401(k) Plan. EO/M/F/Veterans/Disabled.

Our mission is to be the best partner for those who save and improve patients’ lives. Excellence in delivering upon our mission is dependent upon having a diverse team that is empowered to bring their full, authentic self to work each day. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve, and we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity.

jobs.excerpt: Applications Specialist – ColourantsLocation: France (Home-Based) | Belgium or Southern/Western Germany considered About SolenisSolenis is a leading global producer of specialty chemicals, delivering sustainable solutions for water-intensive industries across consumer, industrial, institutional, food and beverage, and pool and spa water markets.
jobs.description:
Applications Specialist – Colourants

Location: France (Home-Based) | Belgium or Southern/Western Germany considered

About Solenis

Solenis is a leading global producer of specialty chemicals, delivering sustainable solutions for water-intensive industries across consumer, industrial, institutional, food and beverage, and pool and spa water markets.

Our innovative portfolio of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, and monitoring and control systems helps customers optimize operations, enhance product quality, protect critical assets and achieve their sustainability goals.

Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, Solenis operates 69 manufacturing facilities worldwide and employs over 16,100 professionals across 130 countries. Recognized as a 2026 US Best Managed Company for the third consecutive year, we are committed to fostering a culture of safety, diversity, and professional growth.

For more information, visit .

About the Role

We are looking for an Applications Specialist – Colourants to join our EMEA Pulp & Paper organization.

Working at the intersection of papermaking, chemistry, colourants and customer applications, you will partner closely with our Sales, Product Management and our technical teams to provide application expertise, solve customer challenges and develop effective, commercially viable solutions.

The role will initially focus primarily on customers across France. It is home-based, with candidates located in France, Belgium or Southern/Western Germany welcome to apply, provided they are comfortable with regular travel to customer sites in France.

What you’ll do

As an Applications Specialist – Colourants, you will provide technical expertise and application support to our Sales teams and customers, helping them identify effective and commercially viable solutions for their paper coloration needs.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Sales Support & Customer Solutions

  • Partner with Sales teams and customers during technical discussions, product evaluations, presentations and trials.
  • Recommend appropriate colourants, applications, equipment and control solutions based on customer needs.
  • Support customers in optimizing colour formulation, shade matching, wet-end applications and product performance.

2. On-Site Support & Troubleshooting

  • Visit customer and mill sites to support product trials, technical evaluations and troubleshooting.
  • Assess application and performance challenges and provide practical recommendations to improve results.
  • Build trusted relationships with assigned customers and act as a technical point of contact for coloration-related matters.

3. Laboratory & Technical Projects

  • Coordinate application testing and customer-specific evaluations with our Colourantslaboratory in Mönchengladbach, Germany.
  • Interpret technical results and translate them into clear, actionable customer recommendations.
  • Develop and drive technical projects and application concepts that support customer value and business growth.

4. Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Collaborate with our international network of Applications Specialists, Sales, Product Management and laboratory teams.
  • Share technical knowledge and best practices while managing your customer activities and priorities with a high degree of autonomy.

What You’ll Bring

  • A degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Paper Technology, Papermaking or a related scientific/technical field, or equivalent relevant industry experience.
  • Relevant experience within papermaking, pulp & paper, specialty chemicals, colourants/dyes or a related technical applications environment.
  • Good knowledge of papermaking processes and/or paper chemistry. Experience with paper coloration, dyes, shading or deep dyeing is a strong advantage, with training available to develop specialist colorant expertise.
  • Familiarity with colour measurement, shade matching and colour-space systems such as CIELAB (L*a*b*) and LCh is an advantage.
  • Comfortable using digital business and CRM tools; Salesforce experience is an advantage.
  • A customer-focused and commercially aware approach, with strong problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Ability to work autonomously, manage priorities and collaborate within an international team.
  • Fluent French and professional English; German or another European language is an advantage.
  • Willingness to travel regularly across France and occasionally elsewhere in Europe, with a valid driving licence.

We know that great candidates don't always meet every requirement. If you have a strong technical foundation and are motivated to develop your expertise in paper coloration, we encourage you to apply.

What We Offer

At Solenis, we know our people are central to our success. We offer:

  • Competitive compensation and an annual performance-related bonus.
  • Company car, laptop and mobile phone.
  • A home-based role with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Comprehensive technical onboarding and support from experienced specialists.
  • The opportunity to develop deep expertise in a specialized technical field.
  • An international environment with opportunities for professional development and broader European exposure.

Ready to make an impact?

If you enjoy solving technical challenges, working closely with customers and developing specialist expertise within an international environment, we would like to hear from you.

Apply today and help us deliver innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers.

Solenis is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Affirmative Action Employer. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability status.

(version Française plus en bas)

Spécialiste Applications – Colourants

Localisation : France (télétravail) | Belgique ou Allemagne du Sud/Ouest également envisageables

À propos de Solenis

Solenis est un leader mondial de la production de produits chimiques de spécialité, proposant des solutions durables aux industries à forte consommation d’eau dans les secteurs des biens de consommation, de l’industrie, des institutions, de l’agroalimentaire ainsi que du traitement de l’eau des piscines et spas.

Notre portefeuille innovant de solutions chimiques pour le traitement de l’eau, d’auxiliaires de procédés, d’additifs fonctionnels et de systèmes de surveillance et de contrôle aide nos clients à optimiser leurs opérations, améliorer la qualité de leurs produits, protéger leurs équipements critiques et atteindre leurs objectifs en matière de développement durable.

Basé à Wilmington, dans le Delaware, Solenis exploite 69 sites de production dans le monde et emploie plus de 16 100 collaborateurs dans 130 pays. Reconnue en 2026 comme l’une des « US Best Managed Companies » pour la troisième année consécutive, notre entreprise s’engage à promouvoir une culture axée sur la sécurité, la diversité et le développement professionnel.

Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur .

À propos du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Spécialiste Applications – Colorants pour rejoindre notre organisation EMEA Pulp & Paper.

À l’interface entre la fabrication du papier, la chimie, les colorants et les applications clients, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes commerciales, Product Management et techniques afin d’apporter votre expertise applicative, de résoudre les problématiques de nos clients et de développer des solutions efficaces et commercialement viables.

Le poste sera initialement principalement axé sur nos clients en France. Il s’agit d’un poste en télétravail, ouvert aux candidats basés en France, en Belgique ou dans le Sud/Ouest de l’Allemagne, sous réserve d’être disponibles pour des déplacements réguliers sur les sites de nos clients en France.

Vos missions

En tant que Spécialiste Applications – Colorants, vous apporterez votre expertise technique et votre support applicatif à nos équipes commerciales et à nos clients afin de les aider à identifier des solutions efficaces et commercialement viables répondant à leurs besoins en matière de coloration du papier.

1. Support technico-commercial & solutions clients

  • Accompagner les équipes commerciales et les clients lors des échanges techniques, évaluations de produits, présentations et essais.
  • Recommander les colorants, applications, équipements et solutions de contrôle les plus adaptés aux besoins des clients.
  • Accompagner les clients dans l’optimisation des formulations de couleurs, la correspondance des teintes, les applications en partie humide (wet-end) et la performance des produits.

2. Support sur site & résolution de problèmes

  • Intervenir sur les sites clients et dans les papeteries afin d’accompagner les essais produits, les évaluations techniques et la résolution de problèmes.
  • Analyser les problématiques liées aux applications et aux performances et proposer des recommandations concrètes permettant d’améliorer les résultats.
  • Développer des relations de confiance avec les clients qui vous sont confiés et agir comme leur interlocuteur technique de référence pour les sujets liés à la coloration.

3. Laboratoire & projets techniques

  • Coordonner les essais d’application et les évaluations spécifiques aux clients avec notre laboratoire Colorants basé à Mönchengladbach, en Allemagne.
  • Interpréter les résultats techniques et les traduire en recommandations claires et concrètes pour les clients.
  • Développer et piloter des projets techniques et des concepts d’application contribuant à créer de la valeur pour nos clients et à soutenir la croissance de l’activité.

4. Collaboration & partage des connaissances

  • Collaborer avec notre réseau international de Spécialistes Applications ainsi qu’avec les équipes commerciales, Product Management et laboratoire.
  • Partager votre expertise technique et les bonnes pratiques, tout en gérant vos activités clients et vos priorités avec un haut niveau d’autonomie.

Votre profil

  • Diplôme en chimie, ingénierie chimique, technologie papetière, fabrication du papier ou dans un domaine scientifique/technique connexe, ou expérience professionnelle équivalente dans le secteur.
  • Expérience pertinente dans la fabrication du papier, l’industrie des pâtes et papiers, les produits chimiques de spécialité, les colorants/teintures ou un environnement similaire d’applications techniques.
  • Bonne connaissance des procédés de fabrication du papier et/ou de la chimie papetière. Une expérience de la coloration du papier, des colorants, de la correction de teinte ou de la teinture en profondeur constitue un réel atout. Une formation pourra être proposée afin de développer une expertise spécialisée dans les colorants.
  • Une connaissance de la mesure des couleurs, de la correspondance des teintes et des espaces colorimétriques tels que CIELAB (L*a*b*) et LCh constitue un atout.
  • À l’aise avec les outils numériques professionnels et les CRM ; une expérience de Salesforce constitue un avantage.
  • Forte orientation client et sens commercial, associés à de solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et en communication.
  • Capacité à travailler de manière autonome, à gérer les priorités et à collaborer au sein d’une équipe internationale.
  • Français courant et anglais professionnel ; l’allemand ou une autre langue européenne constitue un atout.
  • Disponibilité pour des déplacements réguliers en France et occasionnels dans d’autres pays européens, avec un permis de conduire valide.

Nous savons que les meilleurs candidats ne répondent pas toujours à l’ensemble des critères. Si vous disposez de solides bases techniques et souhaitez développer votre expertise dans le domaine de la coloration du papier, nous vous encourageons à postuler.

Ce que nous vous offrons

Chez Solenis, nous savons que nos collaborateurs sont au cœur de notre réussite. Nous proposons :

  • Une rémunération compétitive ainsi qu’un bonus annuel lié à la performance.
  • Une voiture de fonction, un ordinateur portable et un téléphone mobile.
  • Un poste en télétravail offrant un haut niveau d’autonomie.
  • Un programme d’intégration technique complet et l’accompagnement de spécialistes expérimentés.
  • L’opportunité de développer une expertise approfondie dans un domaine technique spécialisé.
  • Un environnement international offrant des possibilités de développement professionnel et une exposition plus large à l’échelle européenne.

Prêt(e) à faire la différence ?

Si vous aimez résoudre des problématiques techniques, travailler au plus près des clients et développer une expertise spécialisée dans un environnement international, nous serions ravis d’échanger avec vous.

Postulez dès aujourd’hui et contribuez avec nous au développement de solutions innovantes et durables pour nos clients.

Solenis s’engage à promouvoir un environnement de travail inclusif et est fier d’être un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances et appliquant une politique d’action positive. Nous valorisons la diversité et ne pratiquons aucune discrimination fondée notamment sur l’âge, l’origine, la couleur de peau, la religion, le sexe, l’orientation sexuelle, l’identité de genre, la nationalité ou le handicap.

PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

Building the AI Infrastructure for Construction

  • Construction is one of the largest industries in the world - and one of the most operationally fragmented.

  • Before anything gets built, projects must move through permitting and pre-construction workflows spread across ~20,000 jurisdictions, each with different rules, systems, and processes.

  • The result is a massive bottleneck slowing down housing and infrastructure across the country.

  • PermitFlow is rebuilding this layer from the ground up - using modern software and AI systems to automate and orchestrate permitting end-to-end.

  • We are still early. The product surface area is expanding rapidly, the workflows are deeply complex, and the opportunity to shape how this industry operates is enormous.

  • This is one of those rare moments where product decisions directly influence how the physical world gets built.

Location

  • Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (Monday, Wednesday and Friday in-office). We prefer NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation.

Role Overview

  • We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Head of Product Operations to build and lead PermitFlow’s Product Operations function.

  • In this role, you will define how our Product organization plans, operates, launches, and measures its work. You will evolve our Product Operations capabilities from a small team into a well-staffed, strategic organization that partners closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Operations, and the founding team to help the company execute more effectively.

  • You’ll be responsible for hiring and developing a team of Product Operations Managers, defining the company’s Product operating system and quality standards, and building the systems and processes that enable great product execution at scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and lead PermitFlow’s Product Operations organization, evolving it into a strategic partner embedded across the business.

  • Hire and develop a team of Product Operations Managers to support stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, Customer Success, Operations, and more.

  • Define PermitFlow’s Product operating system, including planning processes, PRD standards, launch processes, product metrics, customer feedback systems, and cross-functional collaboration models.

  • Do hands-on Product Operations work yourself, particularly on the systems and programs that set the quality bar for the rest of the team.

  • Own and evolve the systems that support Product planning, execution, launches, and measurement to ensure consistency, scalability, and clarity as the company grows.

  • Establish consistent quality standards and review processes across the Product organization, ensuring teams have clear goals, requirements, success metrics, and launch plans.

  • Partner closely with leadership to improve Product execution in ways that directly impact business metrics, including activation, retention, customer satisfaction, and product velocity.

  • Set the vision for how AI transforms the Product Operations function, driving adoption of AI tools and evolving workflows across the team.

What We’re Looking For

We’re open to calibrating the level of this role based on the candidate’s experience and scope of impact, from Manager through Head of Product Operations. We’re ultimately looking for the strongest product operations leader for the business, with title and scope matched to their track record and leadership experience.

  • 8+ years of experience in Product Operations, Business Operations, Strategy & Operations, or B2B SaaS product leadership. Experience supporting complex workflow products with data-heavy systems and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • 3+ years of experience leading and managing teams, ideally in a high-growth startup or technology company.

  • Proven experience building Product Operations teams and functions from early-stage to scale.

  • Exceptional operational judgment across planning, prioritization, product development, launches, measurement, and cross-functional execution. Systems thinking, not just strong project management.

  • Player-coach mentality with the ability to do hands-on Product Operations work while simultaneously building and scaling a team.

  • Active AI fluency, with AI tools integrated into your daily operating workflow. Strong opinions on how AI is changing the way Product Operations teams work and a track record of evolving your own process accordingly.

  • Strong experience standing up Product operating processes, including planning rituals, PRD quality standards, launch readiness, product reviews, customer feedback systems, and product metrics.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership and hold your own in strategic and technical conversations.

  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-moving environment.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • 401(k) savings plan

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

About the Role

We are looking for a financial operator to be the source of truth for Telos Media. You will own the books across four entities and several creative brands, and you will use what you find there to tell leadership where the money is going. The mandate is simple: make the books bulletproof, then tell us what they mean.

This is a dual role. You need to be comfortable wearing both hats, and the second one is what makes this a Controller rather than an accountant:

  • The accounting hat. You own the general ledger. You ensure compliance, accuracy, and a close that lands on time every month.
  • The analyst hat. You own the insight. You explain why a brand is profitable or bleeding, using data you personally verified.

What You'll Do

1. Financial reporting and control

  • GL ownership. Prepare the final general ledger and P&L across all entities for the Head of Finance to sign off. If it is in the books, you vouch for it.
  • The close. Run a disciplined monthly close so leadership receives the financial package (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) by the 10th.
  • Review and quality control. Review the Finance Officer's reconciliations and expense coding. You are the first line of defence against errors reaching leadership.
  • Balance sheet hygiene. A clean balance sheet with no unreconciled suspense accounts and no unexplained transactions.
  • Multi-entity and intercompany. Maintain intercompany balances across US, UK and merchandise entities, and keep the intercompany position clean and reconcilable.

2. FP&A and strategic insight

  • Cost allocation. Build and maintain the logic mapping shared overhead (finance, HR, leadership) to specific brands. The measure is an accurate net profit per brand.
  • Variance analysis. Lead the monthly forecast-versus-actual review. Do not report the difference; explain the driver behind it.
  • Bleed analysis. Deep dives into struggling or new ventures to identify exactly where cash is leaking.
  • Channel P&L. Maintain individual P&Ls for creative channels so unit economics are visible.

⚡ What we’re doing

We are on a mission to eliminate bottlenecks and revolutionize the food and beverage CPG supply chain by developing innovative, all-in-one software that starts with the contract manufacturer.
Contract manufacturers and contract packagers (collectively, co-packers) are facilities that have extra production capacity and provide their services for a fee to customers (brands). Co-packers play a vital role in the trillion dollar U.S. Food and Beverage (F&B) Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry, providing a range of services to convert raw materials into finished goods. These facilities are responsible for blending, drying, baking, frying, forming, and milling raw materials into bottles, pouches, cans, and other packages for our favorite foods and drinks. They are vital businesses for all food and beverage brands, including the thousands of emerging food and beverage brands that lack the resources to handle manufacturing on their own.
We’re building vertical B2B SaaS for F&B manufacturers to run all aspects of their daily operations from estimating costs and ordering raw materials to tracking inventory, managing communication with food and beverage brands, and automating production tasks. Our platform consolidates fragmented software systems and streamline workflows both internally within their business, and externally as they collaborate with their brand customers.

👬 Who we are

Our founding team is no stranger to the complexities of the F&B industry. Our CEO Crawford launched coffee-focused beverage brands and began advising numerous CPG brands and manufacturers. He has lived and breathed the supply chain and manufacturing problems in the food and beverage industry as both an entrepreneur and investor. Our CTO Soheil has 6+ years of experience as a senior software engineer and tech lead at Amazon AWS and Google, across the full stack of software development and scaling and leading engineering teams. And, we're not alone.

We believe that our team is our greatest competitive advantage and take pride in having a team of exceptional humans. As a team, we value integrity, customer obsession, bias for action, lean product development, ownership and accountability. Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.
