As cybercrime and payment fraud continue to evolve, Eftsure provides businesses with a critical control designed to help ensure they never pay the wrong people. We are growing globally across the United States, Australia and Europe – and with that growth comes increasing legal, regulatory, risk and governance complexity.

We are now looking for an experienced General Counsel to join our Executive Leadership Team and help protect and enable Eftsure through our next stage of global growth.

About the role

Reporting directly to the CEO, the General Counsel will be Eftsure's senior legal leader globally, responsible for providing strategic legal counsel to the CEO, Board and Executive Leadership Team while overseeing our broader Legal, Risk and Compliance functions.

This is a highly commercial leadership role for someone who can operate comfortably at Board level while remaining close enough to the business to help teams move quickly.

You'll advise across corporate and commercial law, technology and SaaS contracts, privacy and data protection, regulatory compliance, employment matters, intellectual property, M&A and corporate governance. Just as importantly, you'll help Eftsure navigate risk pragmatically – protecting the business without unnecessarily slowing it down.

What you'll be responsible for

  • Act as a trusted legal and strategic advisor to the CEO, Board and Executive Leadership Team.

  • Lead Eftsure's Legal, Risk and Compliance functions across the United States, APAC and Europe.

  • Provide practical commercial advice across corporate and commercial law, technology contracts, partnerships, privacy and data protection, employment law, intellectual property and other matters affecting the business.

  • Review, draft and negotiate complex commercial agreements, including customer, software licensing, vendor, employment and confidentiality agreements.

  • Own Eftsure's approach to legal and regulatory risk, ensuring appropriate frameworks, policies and controls are embedded across the organisation.

  • Keep the Executive Leadership Team and Board ahead of emerging legislation and regulatory developments across the jurisdictions in which Eftsure operates.

  • Lead and support M&A and other corporate transactions, including due diligence, deal structuring and post-transaction integration.

  • Support Board and corporate governance activities, including Board materials, resolutions and corporate secretarial requirements.

  • Oversee data privacy, cybersecurity and broader legal and regulatory compliance.

  • Manage litigation, disputes and claims and oversee relationships with external counsel.

  • Build scalable legal infrastructure, including contract templates, negotiation playbooks, workflows and processes that support Eftsure's continued growth.

What we're looking for

We're looking for an established senior legal leader who combines exceptional legal judgement with strong commercial instincts.

You'll ideally bring:

  • A Juris Doctor (JD), or regional equivalent, from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing with at least one US state bar. California, Texas, New York or Florida admission is preferred.

  • 15+ years' post-qualification legal experience, including significant in-house experience, ideally within SaaS, fintech or technology.

  • Previous experience as a General Counsel or senior legal leader, with experience leading both senior and junior legal professionals.

  • Experience operating within a scaling, venture-backed or PE-backed global technology business.

  • Strong experience across commercial contracting, corporate law, privacy, data protection and cybersecurity.

  • Experience advising a Board and senior executives on complex legal, governance and risk matters.

  • Experience supporting M&A and corporate transactions.

  • The ability to operate effectively across multiple jurisdictions, particularly the United States, APAC and Europe.

  • Exposure to frameworks such as ISO 27001, ISO 27701 and SOC 2 is highly regarded.

  • Fluency in another language, particularly French, is advantageous but not required.

The kind of leader who will thrive here

You're commercially minded and know that great in-house legal advice isn't simply about identifying risk – it's about helping the business understand that risk and make good decisions.

You'll be comfortable moving between a Board-level conversation and the practical detail of a commercial negotiation. You can simplify complex legal issues for non-legal audiences, anticipate issues before they become problems and make sound decisions in an environment that is growing quickly.

You'll also bring the credibility and leadership capability to influence senior stakeholders globally, alongside the autonomy and adaptability required in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

Why Eftsure?

This is an opportunity to take on a genuinely global General Counsel mandate at an important point in Eftsure's growth.

You'll have direct access to the CEO and Board, lead legal and risk strategy across multiple international markets, and have the opportunity to build the frameworks, capability and infrastructure that will support Eftsure as we continue to scale.

If you're an experienced legal leader who enjoys combining legal rigour, commercial judgement and strategic influence, we'd love to hear from you.

We're looking for an experienced Staff Frontend QA Automation Engineer to join our fast-growing tech team in HCMC, focusing on web applications and browser-based user journeys. You’ll be responsible for designing and implementing robust, scalable frontend automation using Playwright to ensure our users have a seamless, high-performance web experience.

Overview:

Our mission is to become the global standard for addressing. Street addresses weren’t designed for 2026. They aren’t accurate enough to specify building entrances, and they don’t exist for parks, rural areas and many parts of the world. This makes it hard to find places and causes problems and inefficiencies on a global scale.

That’s why we created what3words. We divided the world into 3m squares and gave each square a unique combination of three words. It’s the easiest way to find and share precise locations.

Over the last year, what3words has been used in 193 countries, and our monthly active users continue to grow at an impressive pace. Our tech is used by emergency services, delivery companies, eCommerce businesses, ride-hailing apps and NGOs, and is integrated into the navigation systems of millions of cars around the world.

The role:

jobs.excerpt: About PlootoPlooto is a payment automation platform built to help accountants, bookkeepers, and their clients take control of their payables and receivables.
jobs.description:
About Plooto

Plooto is a payment automation platform built to help accountants, bookkeepers, and their clients take control of their payables and receivables. From approval workflows and audit trails to bulk payments and automated reconciliation, Plooto gives customers time back and confidence that their books are accurate and up to date.

Our customers range from busy entrepreneurs to finance teams and non-profits, with a strong footprint among accounting firms and bookkeeping professionals across Canada.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Manager, Privacy & Regulatory Compliance to lead and scale Plooto’s privacy program while helping the business adopt AI, automation, and data-driven technologies responsibly.

Privacy expertise is the foundation of this role. As AI becomes more widely adopted across Plooto, the number and complexity of decisions involving personal and sensitive information will continue to grow. You will help the business navigate these decisions thoughtfully—establishing clear guardrails, identifying material risks, and enabling teams to innovate without creating unnecessary process or paperwork.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who is pragmatic, curious, and comfortable working in areas where the answers are still evolving. We are not looking for someone with decades of AI governance experience. We are looking for a strong privacy professional who is genuinely interested in AI, asks thoughtful questions, keeps up with emerging developments, and is excited to help shape Plooto’s approach.

You will also support the ongoing implementation of Plooto’s Enterprise Risk Management framework and provide additional capacity across the broader regulatory compliance program. Prior depth in ERM or AML/ATF is not essential; what matters is an ability and willingness to learn, apply sound judgment, and contribute where needed.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, People, Operations, and other teams to translate complex requirements into practical, proportionate solutions that help Plooto move quickly and responsibly.

The role reports to the Senior Manager, Compliance within the Payments Strategy & Compliance function.

Key Responsibilities

Privacy is the primary focus of this role. The role will also provide flexible support for enterprise risk management and broader regulatory compliance priorities as business needs evolve

  • Lead and continuously improve Plooto’s privacy program, serving as a primary privacy subject-matter expert and supporting compliance with PIPEDA, Quebec Law 25, Alberta PIPA, BC PIPA, and other applicable privacy requirements.
  • Provide practical privacy guidance to the business, translating legal and regulatory requirements into clear, risk-based actions without creating unnecessary documentation, approvals, or operational friction.
  • Lead privacy assessments for new products, features, vendors, and data uses, including Privacy Impact Assessments. Apply a proportionate approach so the depth of review and documentation reflects the actual level of risk.
  • Help shape Plooto’s approach to responsible AI, developing lightweight, scalable methods for assessing AI tools and use cases across privacy, data use, transparency, retention, access, automated decision-making, and third-party processing.
  • Embed privacy by design into how Plooto operates, partnering with Product, Engineering, Security, People, and other teams early in the development and implementation of new products, AI tools, models, vendors, and automated processes.
  • Manage core privacy operations, including data rights requests, privacy incidents and breach assessments, third-party privacy reviews, cross-border data considerations, and data retention and deletion practices.
  • Monitor emerging privacy, data, and AI developments in Canada and the United States, determine which developments are relevant to Plooto, and convert them into focused, actionable recommendations.
  • Support the rollout and ongoing implementation of Plooto’s Enterprise Risk Management framework, including coordinating risk assessments, maintaining the enterprise risk register, monitoring mitigation activities, and supporting risk reporting.
  • Help make risk management a practical business discipline, working with leaders to identify material risks, clarify ownership, track meaningful actions, and maintain reporting that supports decision-making rather than documentation for its own sake.
  • Support regulatory change and third-party risk activities, helping assess new requirements and higher-risk relationships, identify accountable owners, and track implementation of proportionate controls.
  • Provide flexible support across Plooto’s broader regulatory compliance program, including regulatory initiatives, audits, effectiveness reviews, remediation work, obligations under the Retail Payment Activities Act, and AML/ATF requirements under the PCMLTFA and FINTRAC guidance.
  • Build understanding and accountability across the organization through clear guidance, practical tools, and training on privacy, responsible AI, and risk management.

Qualifications

  • 3–6+ years of hands-on privacy experience, ideally within fintech, payments, technology, banking, financial services, or another regulated environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of Canadian privacy requirements, particularly PIPEDA and Quebec Law 25, with familiarity with Alberta and British Columbia privacy legislation.
  • Practical experience conducting Privacy Impact Assessments, privacy reviews, data rights requests, and privacy incident or breach assessments.
  • The judgment to apply privacy requirements proportionately and develop controls that are defensible, practical, and appropriate to the underlying risk.
  • Genuine curiosity about AI and emerging technologies, including an interest in learning how new tools use data and helping the organization navigate evolving privacy and governance considerations.
  • You do not need extensive AI governance experience. Experience reviewing AI tools, automated processing, emerging technologies, or data-governance matters is an asset.
  • An ability to simplify complex requirements and create clear guidance, decision frameworks, and processes that people will actually use.
  • A practical, action-oriented mindset. You are comfortable building structure where it is needed while avoiding bureaucracy that does not meaningfully reduce risk.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to work collaboratively across Product, Engineering, Security, People, Operations, Legal, and leadership teams.
  • The ability to independently manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and recognize when an issue requires escalation.
  • Familiarity with U.S. privacy frameworks, including CCPA/CPRA and emerging state privacy laws, is an asset.
  • Exposure to enterprise risk management, third-party risk, fintech regulation, payments compliance, or AML/ATF is helpful but not required. You should be curious and willing to build knowledge in these areas with the support of the broader Compliance team.
  • CIPP/C certification is preferred. CIPP/US, CIPM, or other relevant privacy certifications are assets.
  • Bilingualism in English and French is an asset given Plooto’s Canadian regulatory obligations.

Why Become a Plootonian?

If you’re looking to make a meaningful impact, look no further. We’re transforming the payments space in North America by delivering an unrivalled product experience that solves a real and pressing problem for SMBs.

One of the biggest challenges small businesses face is managing their finances and cash flow—and Plooto helps address that. We have strong product-market fit, a significant opportunity ahead, and the backing of experienced fintech leaders.

You’ll join a team that cares deeply about customer impact, takes pride in its craft, and moves with urgency. We’re just getting started, and you’ll help shape the next chapter of our growth story.

Join Plooto and be part of a mission that matters.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Plooto is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can thrive. We know great teams are built through diverse thinking, and we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification listed.

Accommodation is available throughout the recruitment process in accordance with applicable accessibility legislation. If you require accommodation at any stage, please let us know—we’re happy to work with you.

This posting is for one available position. Compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, and overall alignment with the role.

What's missing is the glue: the part that turns a set of products into one obvious way to say "deploy my workload to bunny." That glue is yours: projects, environments like dev, staging, and production, secrets shared at the right level, logs you can actually read, and a container that talks to a database without a detour through the docs.

Product Engineering sits inside Engineering. There's no Product Manager handing over requirements: you carry the product responsibilities yourself, and you shape solutions with your engineers in the codebase, not just in the conversation. How much you build yourself depends on you and on what the team needs, but shipping code is part of the role, not a bonus.

It’s a role for someone who loves both the why and the how, combining strong product judgment with technical depth, and knowing when to get hands-on and when to help others find the way forward.

You’ll have the context to see the bigger picture, the freedom to challenge assumptions, and teams that challenge your thinking right back.

If you love being close to developers, turning a blank page into something people ship on every day, and helping a team get the details right, you'll feel right at home here.

What will you do?

  • Design the primitives developers use, such as projects, environments, secrets, and logs, and how they behave across Magic Containers, Edge Scripting, and Database, so deploying, configuring, connecting, and debugging a workload on bunny.net feels like one product

  • Shape Developer Platform product direction from discovery through delivery and iteration, turning developer insights into clear priorities

  • Spot and resolve platform or product decisions that break the unified developer experience before they ship

  • Bring clarity to hard problems and give teams the context to make great decisions on their own, raising the bar for product thinking, technical judgment, and ownership beyond your own team

  • Lead a small engineering team: set direction, develop people, give clear feedback, and hold a high bar for what you ship and run

  • Build alongside your engineers across prototypes, APIs, dashboard, instrumentation, docs, and production code

  • Define and measure success, from first deploy to adoption and expansion, and use what you learn to decide what comes next

  • Work across Compute, Frontend, Design, and Product Marketing to create a cohesive experience across the dashboard, API, CLI, and docs

What will you bring?

  • Ideally, you’ve owned the full discovery → delivery → iteration loop at meaningful scale, or you’re ready to take on that level of end-to-end ownership

  • Strong product judgment and a knack for turning messy, ambiguous problems into meaningful outcomes

  • Comfort with data: knowing what to measure, what funnels and retention curves are telling you, and when to run an experiment

  • Business and market literacy: ICP, pricing, competition, revenue drivers, and how your product supports bunny.net's wider strategy

  • Strong technical depth to challenge solutions, make trade-offs, and ship production changes yourself

  • A high bar for quality, reliability, performance, security, and customer trust

  • A track record of helping others make better decisions and take more ownership

  • Clear communication, high ownership, and low ego

  • AI fluency: using AI thoughtfully across research, analysis, prototyping, coding, testing, and communication, while staying accountable for quality

What will make us extra happy?

  • Experience building developer platforms, deployment tools, or products where the developer experience is the product

  • You've deployed, configured, and debugged your own workloads on similar platforms

  • You’re as comfortable talking to customers as you are digging into the technology

  • You naturally think beyond individual features and see how products, systems, and teams fit together

  • Experience leading engineers: developing people, giving feedback, and creating the conditions for a team to make product decisions rather than execute tasks

Where should you be located?

Europe, ideally within CET ±3 hours so collaboration with the team feels natural rather than scheduled.

What's in it for you?

Life at bunny.net comes with benefits that make work (and life) better.

  • 100% flexible hours - Your work, your rhythm. Whether you thrive at 3 am or on a beach at noon, we've got you.

  • Remote-first by design - No offices, no commute, just the freedom to work anywhere. Miss the office? We’ll give you a 3-night voucher for visiting our headquarters.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance - Coverage worldwide.

  • Paid time off - Love the slopes or the sea? Enjoy them with 25 vacation days, plus an extra loyalty day each year, capped at 5 years (30 days total), on top of your local public holidays.

  • Meeting-free Thursdays - We keep Thursdays meeting free internally so you can focus on deep work without interruptions.

  • Home office budget - We believe everyone is more efficient working in a comfortable office, and we're happy to help you set it up with an annual budget of €500.

  • Paid sick leave - Feeling ill? Take time off to fully recover without having to worry about your finances.

  • Parental leave - Paid 16 weeks for birthing parents, 8 weeks for non-birthing parents. If your country gives more, that’s your baseline. If it gives less, we top it up. Take your leave all at once or split it across the first year for maximum flexibility. After paid leave, your local statutory rules apply.

  • Annual fluffle building - We're remote, but not distant! Once a year, we meet in a sunny location where virtual high-fives turn into real ones.

  • Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) - Everyone at bunny.net gets a piece of the pie, starting with 0.01% equity.

  • Mental health support - Feeling down? We've got your back. bunny.net provides mental health resources and help via .

  • Wellness budget - An annual well-being budget of €480 is here to help you stay fresh and focused.

  • Educational budget - €500 yearly for books, seminars, or online courses to keep your learning on track, work-related or not.

Description

TripleTen is a career learning platform for people in a world being reshaped by AI. We help people learn the tech and AI skills to move into higher-paying roles and keep up as the economy shifts. Established in 2019, we are part of Nebius Group, a global leader in AI infrastructure. We work remotely across the US, Europe, LatAm, and beyond.

About the role

﻿

Our brand and marketing team ships a lot with few people across several zones, and the small work has outgrown us: pages to update, articles to republish, tickets going stale, finished work nobody can find. This role picks that up and puts a system under it. The biggest recurring piece is the blog. Search engines were happy to leave a good article alone for a year; AI assistants are not, so everything we publish gets refreshed regularly.

You’ll report to our Brand Director and work closely with a strong team of brand, organic and social media marketers, designers, and copywriter.

What you will do

  • Blog refresh: Work closely with our SEO/GEO Growth Engineer to update roughly 10-20 published articles a month with Claude. Update facts, tighten structure, put finished text live and check if its formatting, links, images, and copy landed well.
  • Small page edits: Minor changes on live pages—a date, a price, a link. Our Claude agents know where the components live, but they need you to tell what to change.
  • Coordination: Chase the pieces an article needs before it ships: a student quote, a cover brief, a fresh instructor photo; ping a vendor for a lost invoice, get it and upload into our internal billing system.
  • The records: Keep the change log and team’s Jira board current.
  • The system: help us identify repeatable tasks and their cadence to initiate automations and then keep them running.

Requirements

  • Hands-on work with Claude or similar: You've used one on real work, and you know where it gets things wrong.
  • Junior project-management skill: You carry a batch of small tasks at once and close them without being chased. You'd rather build a system than keep remembering.
  • A careful eye: You catch a wrong number, a dead link, a changed heading.
  • B2+ English: Strong enough to spot AI patterns in published copy and hear when a sentence stops sounding natural.
  • Comfortable in a repo and a tracker: we use GitHub + Claude Code, WordPress, Jira, Figma, Notion. If you’re not familiar with them, be prepared to pick up quickly.

Nice to have:

  • Basic marketing understanding: enough context to see why a page, an article, or a funnel exists, how they get found, and question links with no UTMs.
  • Experience keeping a team's tickets, files, or documentation in order.

What we can offer you

  • Remote, part-time collaboration (about 20 hours per week).
  • Room to grow into more hours, full-time and a wider role in brand, marketing, or production.
  • Full onboarding into our AI-first stack and our brand kit.
  • A close-knit global team across the US, Europe, and LatAm.

TripleTen is an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, religion, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, protected military/veteran status, or any other legally protected factor.

What we are looking for

This role exists to optimise how people and partners are deployed across global portfolios, ensuring the right talent is on the right projects at the right time. You’ll oversee day-to-day resourcing, balancing full-time and contractor teams to meet delivery needs and operational goals. Acting as a bridge between Delivery, Creative, Strategy, and Operations, you’ll resolve capacity conflicts, facilitate portfolio resourcing discussions, and ensure global capacity is leveraged effectively. This is a strategic and hands-on role requiring strong commercial acumen, stakeholder management, and operational rigour.

What you will do:

Resource Planning & Allocation

  • Oversee daily resourcing across multiple client portfolios, in close partnership with Delivery and Creative/Strategy leads.
  • Lead global portfolio resourcing calls, facilitating capacity discussions and resolving conflicts quickly and pragmatically.
  • Partner with global counterparts to manage cross-regional allocations and ensure equitable workload distribution.

Contractor Management

  • Oversee all administrative and operational aspects of onboarding, extensions, and offboarding for contingent talent.
  • Ensure freelancer usage is within commercial targets and aligned with hiring policy.
  • Ensure compliance with IR35 and TMP’s vendor management standards.
  • Track and report on contractor spend and usage patterns, providing insight to Delivery and Finance teams.

Operational Excellence & Process Improvement

  • Maintain high-quality data in Kantata (and associated systems) to ensure accurate reporting across utilisation, forecasting, and capacity planning.
  • Partner with Business Systems & Data and Finance teams to continuously refine forecasting and time-tracking processes.
  • Drive adoption of new tools, processes, and reporting dashboards within delivery teams.
  • Contribute to the evolution of tmp’s Workforce Operations model by integrating offshoring, specialist resourcing, and flexible capacity models.

People & Partnership

  • Build strong working relationships with Delivery Directors, Client Services, Creative Directors, and Finance partners across the region.
  • Coach and mentor colleagues to develop consistent and proactive resourcing practices.
  • Foster collaboration across regions to create a unified global resourcing culture.

Requirements

Who you are:

  • Calm and solution-oriented under pressure, able to navigate complex or changing scenarios with confidence.
  • Knowledgeable about agency resourcing and the strategic use of contractors, understanding when and why to bring them in for support.
  • Operationally sharp, translating complex policies and processes into simple, efficient workflows.
  • An excellent communicator and collaborator, able to build alignment across Delivery, Client Services, Creative, Strategy, and Operations teams.
  • Highly organized and proactive, with strong follow-through on commitments and the ability to anticipate challenges.
  • Personable problem-solver who brings clarity and calm to tense situations, keeping operations running smoothly.

What you will need:

  • 3-5+ years of experience in resourcing, workforce planning, or operations within marketing, digital, or professional services environments.
  • Deep understanding of project delivery cycles in creative or B2B marketing contexts.
  • Advanced skills in resource planning and operational tools such as Kantata/Mavenlink, Float, 10kft, Smartsheet, and Excel.
  • Strong commercial mindset, able to balance financial efficiency with operational and resourcing excellence.
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively and manage stakeholders across senior levels.
  • Confident operating in a complex, matrixed, global environment.

Benefits

What we offer in return

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance: Health is a priority worth investing in. We empower every employee to take charge of their health by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance so they can perform at their best ability.
  • Pre-tax flexible spending account (FSA) – healthcare, dependent care, and transit available: We are committed to saving you money as we provide high-quality healthcare that is as flexible and diverse as our team.
  • 4% 401(k) contribution with no vesting period: We are invested in our employees' careers. Each individual has the opportunity to build a future for themselves through a 401(k), and we see that as a success for the company as well.
  • Plentiful paid time off: Each employee has the freedom to choose how long they want to be away from work. We recommend at least 20 days of PTO, so employees can fully rest and avoid burnout.
  • Sick leave (15 days annually): Illnesses are taken seriously at tmp. We provide 15 days of sick leave so employees can take their time to make a full recovery before returning to work.
  • Holiday shutdown (December 26th - 29th): As the whole company shuts down for a few days, you can celebrate the holidays with loved ones.
  • Parental leave:
    • Primary caregiver: 12 weeks full pay and then 12 weeks 50% pay
    • Secondary caregiver: 12 weeks full pay
  • Access to Unmind: Our well-being platform, including access to therapists and coaches
  • Employer-funded life, AD&D & disability insurance: tmp offers all employees life and AD&D insurance and makes sure you and your loved ones are protected in times of need.
  • Company getaways: Whether it is a local office holiday party or a full-blown international trip, we believe in bonding through quality time spent together as a team.

We are currently eligible to hire within these US states:

CA, CO, IL, WA, and TX.

A note on applying:

Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway. Research shows some people hold back unless they meet 100% of the requirements. We do not want that to be you.

At tmp, we hire for potential, mindset, and character as much as experience. If you are excited about the role but your background is not a perfect match, we would still love to hear from you. You might be exactly what we are looking for, either for this role or another.

Diversity equals increased creativity, which equals better results for all. We’re committed to equality of opportunity and applications from all individuals are encouraged. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please don’t hesitate to let us know.

Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.

Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.

We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

  • Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
  • Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
  • Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
  • Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

  • Build digital products and services 0-1
  • Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
  • Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
  • Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
  • Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process
  • Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics
  • Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users
  • Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
  • Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
  • Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
  • Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
  • Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
  • Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
  • Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
  • Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

Abridge's Core Product Experiences pillar is the foundation of everything we do — the documentation and workflow experiences that clinicians interact with every day, and the engine that drives adoption, retention, and expansion across our customer base. Deployed across 250+ health systems, Abridge has powered over 80 million clinical conversations — and that number is accelerating. Yet the opportunity ahead is massive: clinicians see the potential to accelerate more of their workflows through AI, health system expectations are growing, and the competitive landscape is intensifying.

This is an opportunity to drive meaningful impact on clinicians' lives, at scale, across some of the largest health systems in the United States.

We are looking for a Product Manager to own product strategy and execution for a core product area. You'll build the workflows, systems, and AI-generated artifacts that help clinicians with their daily lives — whether preparing for visits, completing documentation, or reducing administrative burden after the patient leaves. You'll do this across care settings: ambulatory, emergency, and inpatient.

This is a role for a builder — someone with strong product taste, deep user empathy, and the drive to ship experiences that clinicians love. You'll spend significant time with physicians, and care teams to understand how they actually work, then translate those insights into product decisions that move our most important metrics. You'll work across ML, engineering, design, clinical science, and commercial teams to deliver outcomes features.

What You'll Do

  • Own product strategy for a Core Product area. Define the vision, roadmap, and success metrics for your domain — whether that's note quality, clinical workflows, personalization, or care settings. Prioritize ruthlessly based on user impact, competitive dynamics, and data.

  • Go deep with clinicians. Conduct hands-on user research — shadowing clinicians in exam rooms, watching them interact with notes, understanding the friction they face across specialties and care settings. Turn those insights into product conviction.

  • Ship high-quality clinical workflows. Partner with engineering, design, and ML to build experiences that are intuitive, reliable, and clinically useful. Sweat the details — you care about the difference between a note that's "fine" and one that makes a clinician trust the product.

  • Integrate deeply with EHR environments. Work across Epic and other EHR surfaces to ensure Abridge workflows fit seamlessly into existing clinical routines. Understand the constraints and opportunities of embedded vs. standalone experiences.

  • Define metrics and drive outcomes. Establish clear KPIs — adoption, retention, encounter share, quality scores — and use data to evaluate what's working. Build a culture of measurement and iteration on your team.

  • Navigate ambiguity and move fast. Create structure and clarity in areas where the right answer isn't obvious. Form hypotheses, test them quickly, and update your approach when the data says you're wrong.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience shipping products that users love, with a track record of owning product areas end-to-end.

  • Builder mentality. You've personally driven products from discovery through launch and iteration. You care about craft and quality in what you ship.

  • Strong user empathy and product taste. You instinctively know the difference between a product that works and one that delights. You've built that instinct through direct, repeated exposure to users.

  • Healthcare or clinical workflow experience strongly preferred. You understand how clinicians work, how health systems buy, and why healthcare products are hard to get right.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. You can take a messy problem space and create a clear roadmap without waiting for perfect information.

  • Cross-functional credibility. You can go deep with ML engineers on model tradeoffs, partner with design on interaction details, and present strategy to health system executives. You earn trust through competence and follow-through.

Bonus Points If…

  • You have built ML/AI-powered products and understand how to design around model capabilities and limitations.

  • You have worked with Epic or other EHR platforms and understand what it takes to build great embedded experiences.

  • You actively use AI tools in your own work — prototyping, analysis, writing, coding — and have strong intuition for how AI products should behave and where they fall short.

  • You have a technical background (engineering, CS, or similar) and are comfortable going deep on system design, data models, and technical tradeoffs with engineering teams.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

jobs.excerpt: We are hiring a VC Analyst Intern to research the market and write what we find.
jobs.description:
We are hiring a VC Analyst Intern to research the market and write what we find.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the ones that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

The role

Why is this company worth a look, and why now? Is this sector heating up, or is everyone already late to it? Which investor actually belongs in this round, and which one is only circling?

You answer those in writing. Every piece of work here is a memo. A view, the reasoning underneath it, and the part you are not sure about said out loud. The ones that hold up get published on our LinkedIn, the blog on our site, the newsletter and our X.

You also write for the two audiences we sell to. A family office and a pre seed founder want different things from the same piece of news, and a lot of what you write goes out from the founders' own accounts, in their voice.

You work with the two co-founders directly, and with our Head of Brand once that seat is filled. The org is very flat, so you learn straight from us how we screen, what we pass on and why.

This is a paid internship built to grow into a full time seat. We are looking for someone who already follows this market closely, has opinions about it, and wants to spend the next few years writing about it properly.

What you will own

  • Company memos. Why a company is interesting, who belongs in the round, and what would have to be true for it to fail.

  • Sector work. What is heating up, what is over owned, and the evidence behind both.

  • Investor research. Who is actually active, in what, at what stage, and what they are known for.

  • The published version of all of it, plus the pieces written for family offices and early stage founders that go out from the founders' accounts.

You are a fit if you

  • Already follow this market closely because you enjoy it. You can name the rounds from this quarter and say which ones you think are wrong.

  • Already write and research in this space, and turn that into memos or articles yourself.

  • Get the facts right. A wrong fund name, round size or attribution costs credibility we cannot buy back.

  • Use AI every day, and know where it should go nowhere near your work. Good judgement and taste on where it makes you faster, and where it degrades what you put out.

What we offer

Remote and async.

  • Close contact with the co-founders and our Head of Brand directly.

  • Close contact with our internal team.

  • Our network of highly established investors and the top deals out there.

  • Access to our internal processes, and to how we screen deal flow.

  • Learning very closely from all of us.

The Senior Clinical Data Engineer leads the strategic development and optimization of clinical data systems to support regulatory compliance, advanced analytics, and operational excellence across global trials.

With deep expertise in SAS Programming in a Life Sciences setting, you'll be responsible for building and maintaining modular codebases, sets coding standards, and mentoring junior engineers. Through dynamic dashboards and analytics tools, you'll deliver actionable insights into trial performance and data quality. As a strategic liaison across Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, and Regulatory Affairs, you'll help translate clinical requirements into scalable technical solutions and leads the design of secure, high-performance databases and ETL pipelines integrating data from diverse clinical systems.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

Data Standardization & Mapping: Spearhead the development of enterprise-level data mapping strategies that transform raw clinical data into standardized formats for high-impact analytics. Lead the adoption and governance of data standards across programs to ensure regulatory alignment and consistency.

Data Quality Assurance: Design and implement robust, scalable validation frameworks that proactively detect and resolve systemic data issues. Serve as a strategic partner to Clinical Data Managers and cross-functional teams, driving continuous improvement in data integrity across global trials

Programming & Scripting: Architect and maintain advanced, modular codebases using SAS to support complex data engineering workflows. Python, R, and SQL experience is highly preferred as we continue to leverage Ai tools across the industry. Establishing coding standards and mentoring junior engineers in automation, reproducibility, and performance optimization. Example use cases includes edit checks, reconciliations, exception listings, programmed protocol deviations, resource projections based on site data entry volume

Reporting & Visualization: Develop and operationalize dynamic dashboards and analytics tools that provide real-time insights into data quality, trial progress, and operational KPIs. Translate complex datasets into actionable intelligence for clinical and regulatory stakeholders.

Collaboration & Cross-Functional Support: Act as a strategic liaison between Clinical Data Engineering and Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, and Regulatory Affairs. Translate clinical and scientific requirements into scalable technical solutions that support study execution and data delivery.

Database Design & Optimization: Lead the design and optimization of secure, high-performance relational databases and data lakes. Ensure infrastructure scalability, query efficiency, and data governance for large-scale clinical datasets.

Design. This is the primary need. Visual identity systems, campaign creative, web design partnership with our digital team, sales and marketing collateral, and pitch materials. You set the visual standard for everything that leaves the agency, and your hands are on the work.

Brand strategy. Positioning, messaging architecture, voice and tone, audience and persona development, naming, and the strategic briefs that drive every creative engagement. You'll work directly with our Differentiator Framework and help operationalize it for client work.

jobs.excerpt: About the CompanyZenara Health is a tech-driven mental healthcare organization dedicated to improving both the accessibility and quality of mental wellness services.
jobs.description:
About the Company

Zenara Health is a tech-driven mental healthcare organization dedicated to improving both the accessibility and quality of mental wellness services. We combine AI-powered platforms with professional clinical care to deliver tailored and effective mental health solutions, ensuring a smooth digital experience for patients and providers alike. As a startup, we operate independently rather than as a mere department.

About the Role

This position is not suitable for an "AI strategy consultant" who specializes in creating presentations about potential future applications of AI.

If your experience is mainly in research prototypes, offline benchmarks, or demo-driven AI, this opportunity may not be the right fit. Our focus is on developing systems that operate continuously, fail gracefully, and build trust over time.

Our AI pipeline encompasses LLM orchestration, clinical NLP, assessment scoring, and active production workflows, and it is fully operational today. Your responsibility will be to expand it into a thoroughly documented, robust AI organization with established processes, team structure, and technical leadership.

AI is the distinguishing factor at Zenara — it is not an add-on feature but the essence of our product functionality. You will be responsible for AI strategy across all Zenara products: our assessment tool (which provides AI-generated clinical insights), our care/practice platform (which features AI-assisted operations), and our AI infrastructure framework. You will collaborate closely with our Head of Engineering (your peer, not your subordinate) to integrate AI deeply into the platform.

The industry is evolving rapidly. We need someone who can manage complex AI workflows, AI-assisted coding pipelines, and scale AI infrastructure. This role requires not just the deployment of models but also the development of organizational capabilities to deliver AI products at the pace of a startup.

This role does not focus on "AI strategy" in terms of presentation-making. You will be actively involved: reviewing pipelines, troubleshooting orchestration failures, making model selection decisions, managing complex coding workflows, and delivering production AI solutions that improve clinical care.

What You Will Own

1. AI/ML Strategy Across All Products

You will establish the AI roadmap and architecture for our assessment and care/practice products, as well as our infrastructure platform. Your crucial decisions will include model selection, orchestration frameworks, and determining when to build or buy solutions. Your architectural decisions will shape the platform for years to come.

2. AI Engineering Team

You will assemble and lead the AI engineering team, starting with one direct report and expanding to 3-4 team members. You will be responsible for hiring, setting performance standards, providing coaching, and cultivating the team's culture. Your goal will be to develop AI engineering talent capable of delivering at startup speed.

3. Production AI Infrastructure

You will design and implement scalable AI pipeline infrastructure. This includes creating systems that facilitate LLM orchestration, clinical NLP, and AI-generated insights. You will also establish monitoring, testing, and incident response protocols for all AI workflows. If a pipeline fails, it will be your duty to rectify it.

4. AI Cost as Production Constraint

You will regard AI costs as a key production constraint and ensure transparency in per-workflow and per-customer economics. Your role will involve monitoring and optimizing model usage, inference costs, and token consumption to ensure the economic viability at scale — not just in prototypes.

5. AI System Traceability and Explainability

You will guarantee that AI system behavior is explainable and debuggable for internal teams, rather than merely for end users. You will create observability and logging mechanisms that allow for understanding AI decisions, tracing inputs through the pipeline, and methodically debugging any failures.

6. Documentation and Process

You will develop an AI engineering playbook, documenting workflows, establishing testing standards, and creating runbooks for common incidents. Your effort will turn institutional knowledge from individual contributions into well-documented, transferable processes.

7. Clinical AI Innovation

You will assess and incorporate new models, frameworks, and orchestration tools as the field continues to advance. Staying ahead of the curve, you’ll ensure that Zenara's AI capabilities remain at the forefront of clinical applications.

Your First 90 Days

Week 1-2: Immerse yourself fully. Gain a comprehensive understanding of all AI workflows currently in production, review the existing pipeline architecture, identify significant technical debt and key opportunities, and build rapport with the team through active listening.

Month 1: Set documentation standards to begin capturing organizational knowledge. Define the AI testing and monitoring framework, create a technical roadmap that balances innovation with stability, and start monitoring AI costs by workflow.

Month 2-3: Implement monitoring and alerting for production AI workflows, develop traceability and logging systems for AI decision debugging, initiate the hiring process for your first team member, and commence architectural improvements — not a complete rewrite but a clear evolutionary path. Establish an AI governance framework to ensure clinical compliance.

Ongoing: Take charge of AI responsibilities. Introduce features that enhance clinical outcomes, expand the team, elevate performance expectations, and instill confidence in the CEO regarding the management of AI engineering.

Values & Vibe (Who You Are)

You see AI leadership as fundamentally about **ownership of outcomes** rather than merely exploring research. You thrive in chaotic AI environments, bringing order not through excessive academic rigor but through clarity, accountability, and effective execution. Your experience is rooted in startups or high-growth companies, rather than solely in research institutions. You find AI environments that resemble a black box—marked by heroic debugging rather than standardized practices—unacceptable.

You possess a hands-on approach that allows you to review code, resolve issues, and assess architecture, while understanding your primary responsibility is to empower your team rather than to merely be a contributing member. You have a track record of successfully launching tangible AI products that serve real users within specified timeframes. You comprehend the distinction between an intriguing model and one that reliably supports clinicians.

You have considered aspects related to AI safety, model governance, and production reliability, moving beyond a simplistic "we use the latest GPT" approach. You are aware of the trade-offs between model capabilities, costs, latency, and clinical accuracy, treating the economics of AI as a fundamental concern rather than an afterthought.

What Success Looks Like

  • AI systems consistently yield results, alleviating concerns for the CEO regarding pipeline failures
  • The AI roadmap is clear and aligns with the overall product strategy
  • AI costs are monitored on a per-workflow and per-customer basis, ensuring the business model scales effectively
  • AI system behavior is debuggable, enabling the team to trace decisions and diagnose issues without extraordinary measures
  • AI engineers have defined responsibilities, receive coaching, and benefit from continuous feedback
  • Architectural decisions are well-documented and thoughtfully made
  • Monitoring and alert systems detect issues before they are reported by users
  • The hiring pipeline is active, as you are developing the team while managing current personnel
  • Clinical teams have confidence in AI features due to their reliability
  • The AI organization is more robust, efficient, and trustworthy than it was when you joined

Requirements

Required

- 8 to 14 years of experience in software engineering, including a minimum of 3 years in leadership roles for AI/ML teams within the industry (not solely in academia). You have successfully delivered AI products to actual users.

- Extensive experience with LLM orchestration frameworks at production scale (such as Dify, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent). You have designed and managed production AI pipelines.

- Hands-on experience deploying AI in healthcare or regulated sectors — you are familiar with compliance challenges and have navigated them successfully.

- Strong architectural mindset — you build systems and infrastructure rather than just prompts. You can evaluate issues related to scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.

- Experience with agentic AI workflows and AI-assisted coding pipelines — you appreciate how modern AI teams operate within this framework.

- Supervised teams of 2 to 5+ AI engineers — responsible for direct management, hiring, performance assessments, and mentoring.

- Excellent English communication abilities — you adopt an async-first approach, creating clear written decision memos, technical designs, and risk reports. You effectively document both your decisions and the reasons behind them.

- Startup or fast-paced growth experience — you have thrived in settings defined by uncertainty, resource constraints, and tight deadlines.

Strongly Preferred

- Background in healthcare SaaS (EHR, billing, clinical workflows, HIPAA)

- Knowledge of clinical NLP and behavioral health applications

- Contributions to published research or open-source projects in ML/NLP (though practical industry experience is prioritized)

- Experience in developing AI infrastructure platforms (beyond mere applications)

- Familiarity with observability and monitoring strategies for AI systems

- Skills in managing AI cost budgets and optimizing inference costs

Nice to Have

- Understanding of FHIR/HL7 healthcare data standards

- Experience with multi-tenant SaaS AI deployments

- Awareness of SOC 2 or similar compliance standards

- Exposure to mental health or behavioral health fields

- Knowledge of FDA AI/ML compliance regulations

Schedule

Evening IST hours with 4–8 hours of daily overlap with US Pacific time (9am–5pm PT). You are welcome to propose a schedule that best fits your needs — our priority is on ensuring availability and overlap for the team rather than imposing strict clock-in times. Leadership presence is anticipated during critical deployments or incidents.

Benefits

Benefits

  • Compensation: Well above market for Indian startups at this level. We pay for the caliber we're hiring.
  • Opportunities for fully remote work available throughout India
  • Equipment allowance included
  • Local holidays recognized and observed (India)
  • Flexible paid time off policy
  • Funding available for leadership development and coaching
  • Direct and frequent communication with the CEO, allowing you to connect without intermediaries
  • The chance to build an AI organization from the ground up in a clinically relevant field

About TouchBistro

TouchBistro is an all-in-one restaurant management platform built to help restaurant operators run stronger, more successful businesses. Our solutions span point of sale, payments, front-of-house and back-of-house operations, and guest engagement. As part of Harris Computer, TouchBistro combines the focus and agility of a restaurant technology company with the long-term orientation of a leading vertical market software organization.


The Opportunity

TouchBistro is seeking an experienced Vice President, Sales & Marketing to lead an integrated go-to-market organization across North America. Reporting to the EVP, this executive will translate company strategy into a focused commercial plan, build a predictable and efficient revenue engine, sharpen our market position, and develop high-performing Sales and Marketing teams.

This is a hands-on executive role for a leader who can connect market insight, product value, demand generation, sales execution, pricing, brand, content, web, analytics, and marketing operations. The successful candidate will bring clarity to how TouchBistro targets the right customers, communicates differentiated value, creates and converts demand, and measures performance from first touch through booked and live recurring revenue.

What Success Looks Like

  • A clear, company-wide commercial strategy that defines priority markets, ideal customer profiles, channel choices, value propositions, and measurable growth outcomes.
  • A predictable funnel with disciplined forecasting, strong pipeline hygiene, clear stage definitions, and transparent conversion performance from lead through booking and activation handoff.
  • Improved sales and marketing efficiency, with investment decisions grounded in customer quality, unit economics, expected lifetime value, payback, and live recurring revenue.
  • Stronger product positioning, pricing discipline, launch execution, competitive intelligence, and sales enablement across the TouchBistro portfolio.
  • One integrated Sales and Marketing operating rhythm, with shared priorities, clear accountability, fast learning cycles, and a culture of coaching and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Growth Strategy & Leadership

  • Own the overall Sales and Marketing strategy and operating plan, aligned to TouchBistro’s business priorities, financial objectives, product roadmap, and customer strategy.
  • Translate growth objectives into market, segment, channel, capacity, investment, and talent plans with clear assumptions and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Sales and Marketing leadership team; establish clear decision rights, performance expectations, succession plans, and career paths.
  • Create an integrated operating cadence across Sales and Marketing, including weekly execution reviews, monthly funnel and forecast reviews, and quarterly business planning.
  • Act as a key member of the executive leadership team, bringing a market- and customer-informed perspective to company strategy, resource allocation, and portfolio decisions.

Sales Strategy, Pipeline & Execution

  • Own delivery of new-business revenue targets and the commercial performance of inbound, outbound, and business development motions.
  • Build a disciplined, repeatable sales process covering lead response, qualification, discovery, demonstration, solution fit, proposal, negotiation, contracting, and close.
  • Establish consistent definitions and controls for pipeline creation, stage progression, conversion, forecast categories, sales-cycle velocity, win/loss analysis, and CRM hygiene.
  • Align account coverage, territories, quotas, capacity, and compensation with priority customer segments and expected demand.
  • Develop high-performing sales leaders and teams through structured onboarding, coaching, call review, playbooks, feedback, and clear career paths.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Operations to ensure honest expectations, clean handoffs, customer readiness, and stronger conversion from sold to live.
  • Provide executive sponsorship for strategic prospects, customers, RFPs, and complex commercial negotiations when appropriate.

Demand Generation & Revenue Marketing

  • Set the inbound and outbound demand generation strategy across paid search, SEO, lifecycle nurture, paid social, website, events, webinars, account-based programs, and other relevant channels.
  • Allocate budgets across markets, audiences, and channels based on pipeline contribution, customer quality, conversion, ACV, payback, and return on investment.
  • Build an experimentation roadmap to improve audience targeting, offer design, channel mix, lead quality, conversion, and speed to learning.
  • Create tight alignment between Marketing and Sales on campaign priorities, service-level expectations, lead routing, follow-up, qualification, and feedback loops.
  • Balance short-term pipeline creation with long-term category credibility, brand strength, customer advocacy, and organic demand.

Product Marketing, Pricing & Go-to-Market

  • Own the commercial articulation of TouchBistro’s value proposition, product positioning, messaging architecture, proof points, and differentiation by customer segment and use case.
  • Lead go-to-market planning and execution for new products, bundles, features, releases, and market entries in partnership with Product, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations.
  • Build a disciplined pricing and packaging capability informed by customer value, competitive dynamics, willingness to pay, margin, attach potential, and long-term unit economics.
  • Institutionalize market and competitive intelligence and translate insights into positioning, enablement, pricing, roadmap input, and commercial action.
  • Ensure Sales has the tools, training, battlecards, pricing guidance, customer stories, presentations, and collateral required to sell value consistently.

Brand, Content, Community & Communications

  • Define and protect TouchBistro’s brand strategy, voice, narrative, and standards across digital and traditional customer touchpoints.
  • Oversee an integrated content strategy spanning thought leadership, SEO and answer-engine visibility, product content, customer stories, newsletters, nurture, social media, events, podcasts, webinars, and sales collateral.
  • Ensure content is grounded in restaurant operator needs, product value, customer evidence, industry trends, and clear business objectives across the funnel.
  • Strengthen community engagement, customer advocacy, employee advocacy, and social listening while ensuring timely, consistent brand interaction.
  • Use research and original insights to build credibility in restaurant technology and create reusable demand, PR, sales, partner, and customer assets.

Digital Experience & Web

  • Treat the website and digital ecosystem as core commercial products that support discovery, education, conversion, and customer trust.
  • Own the web roadmap, conversion strategy, user journeys, landing-page effectiveness, accessibility, SEO foundations, performance, scalability, and content-management governance.
  • Use analytics, behavioral data, experimentation, and A/B testing to continuously improve digital conversion and campaign performance.
  • Ensure web development, design, content, product marketing, demand generation, and marketing operations work from shared priorities and measurable outcomes.
  • Oversee external agencies and vendors where needed, with clear scope, accountability, quality standards, and return expectations.

Marketing Operations, Data & Technology

  • Own marketing processes, automation, campaign operations, lead management, attribution, data quality, consent and governance, and the effectiveness of the marketing technology stack.
  • Ensure reliable integration between marketing platforms and CRM, with clear lifecycle definitions, routing, scoring, source tracking, and closed-loop reporting.
  • Develop dashboards that connect activity and spend to pipeline, booked ACV, live ACV, customer quality, payback, and retention-relevant indicators.
  • Create a trusted performance narrative by combining data with actionable insight, identifying root causes, and recommending clear management actions.
  • Simplify tools and workflows, automate repetitive work, and use AI responsibly to improve targeting, content operations, seller productivity, analysis, and speed of execution.

Cross-Functional Commercial Alignment

  • Partner closely with Product to bring customer and competitive insight into roadmap choices, business cases, packaging, launches, and lifecycle decisions.
  • Partner with Finance on targets, budgets, forecast assumptions, unit economics, deal quality, pricing governance, and investment trade-offs.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Operations to improve sales-to-activation handoffs, surface expectation gaps, support retention, and create customer expansion and advocacy opportunities.
  • Build strong relationships with strategic customers and ecosystem partners and represent TouchBistro at relevant industry events and executive forums.
  • Promote direct communication, clear ownership, and shared metrics across the full customer journey.

Performance Management

The VP will establish a concise executive scorecard and use it to drive decisions, accountability, and continuous improvement. Measures are expected to include:


Growth : Booked ACV, live ACV, new recurring revenue, average deal size, attainment by channel and segment

Funnel : Pipeline coverage, lead-to-opportunity conversion, win rate, sales-cycle velocity, forecast accuracy

Efficiency : Sales and Marketing spend to live ACV, CAC and payback, channel ROI, quota capacity and productivity

Customer quality : Ideal-customer mix, sold-to-kickoff and sold-to-live conversion, early-life churn indicators, expectation quality

Marketing : Qualified pipeline contribution, website conversion, content and nurture influence, attribution quality, brand and share-of-voice indicators

Execution : CRM hygiene, speed to lead, campaign delivery, launch readiness, pricing compliance, enablement adoption

People : Engagement, retention, leadership bench strength, ramp time, coaching effectiveness, succession coverage

Qualifications & Experience

Growth Marketing Pro began as a leading marketing blog and has since become a growth marketing agency working with 50+ businesses. Technically, we're an agency, but we don't think of ourselves as one. Our clients use us as a fractional SEO/organic growth team: a superpower they plug into their business to unlock fast, profitable growth.

We're hiring an SEO/AEO Account Manager to deliver WOW results for our organic marketing engagements. Our programs are rooted in SEO and have expanded into what we call Search Everywhere Optimization - AI visibility, citation-earning off-page content, and Reddit organic marketing (we're writing the playbook in these interrelated fields). We deliver on a broader set of organic strategies than anyone else in the game, and bring "ahead of the curve" plays to clients backed by data from across our portfolio.

In this role, you'll directly manage a portfolio of clients, serving as the point of contact and owner of each engagement. You'll function as a fractional Head of SEO, providing strategic leadership of the client's organic program while personally managing the execution that drives results. You'll leverage your existing marketing experience (SEO, content marketing, analytics) combined with intellectual curiosity and a natural inclination to test cutting-edge tactics - and get the opportunity to help build a scaling startup into an industry-leading growth marketing company.

What You'll Own

  • The client relationship: serve as the primary point of contact and owner of the engagement end to end; deeply understand the client’s business goals, establish the KPIs and strategy to achieve them, and operate as an extension of their team
  • Communicate proactively with clients and our internal team – regular check-ins between meetings, flagging anomalies early, and keeping clients informed without waiting for a scheduled touchpoint
  • The strategy and roadmap: own the client’s strategy and deliverable roadmap – build monthly strategies grounded in keyword intent with a laser focus on high-intent keywords that convert, sequence the work, and rigorously manage deliverables, milestones, and ETAs across internal teams and vendors
  • Execution across SEO and AEO: SEO and content campaigns built end-to-end with our in-house Content Team, off-page content that earns citations and brand mentions across Reddit, YouTube, and digital PR, and technical site issues identified and resolved with our web dev resources
  • Help write the playbook for AI visibility – how website content, off-site content, and authority drive a brand's presence across Google and AI platforms like ChatGPT and AI Overviews - and recommend and implement A/B tests, CRO improvements, and similar experiments
  • Measurement, reporting, and results: work in Google Search Console, GA4, HubSpot, and AI search performance tools to track changes and extract the learnings that guide your strategy, and tie performance to the bottom line - conversions, pipeline, and revenue
  • Deliver detailed monthly reporting on the KPIs the client actually cares about and be a storyteller: analyze the “why” and “so what” behind the numbers, clearly communicate what’s working, what’s not, and what we should focus on now, next, and later
  • Growth beyond the scope: be a strategic partner beyond the initial scope by suggesting new channel tests, CRO improvements, and tracking setups, and identifying upsell opportunities

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years delivering revenue growth and business impact through SEO, ideally including in-house experience at a startup or scaling business where exposure across channels is common
  • Fluency in the tools: Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, CRM platforms like HubSpot, and a working familiarity with AI search visibility tracking tools
  • Analytical and results-oriented: you can accurately gather and analyze data to understand SEO + AEO performance. Strong in GA4 and spreadsheets; an "analyst" title somewhere in your background is a plus
  • Rigorous execution and GSD: a bias to action, able to prioritize and execute against a high workload, with keen attention to detail and the ability to keep stakeholders accountable
  • Advanced AI adoption: you're a proficient GPT and Claude user, you use tools like Claude Cowork and Claude Code
  • Artful communicator: strong written and verbal skills, with the ability to tell stories that persuade others to take action. Active listener, sympathetic to the client's situation but unafraid to disagree and offer a counter viewpoint grounded in data
  • Extreme ownership: you treat your clients like your own business. On multi-channel accounts, you stay close to what's happening in other channels, even when they aren't your department
  • Not just an SEO, but a broader "Growth Marketing Pro": you can answer broad strategic growth questions by drawing on experience and pattern matching, hold an informed opinion on CRO and the full funnel, and understand paid search and paid social well enough to advise clients on when and how to use them
  • Resourceful with a growth mindset: you're a pro at teaching yourself new things, you're constantly testing new strategies and documenting the learnings so other clients benefit, and you enjoy the continuous learning process of growth marketing

Bonus points

  • Experience with Reddit organic marketing, digital PR, or community-led growth
  • Hands-on CRO or conversion tracking implementation experience
  • Early experimentation with AEO/AI visibility work

Benefits

  • Compensation: $85,000 – $125,000 per year
  • We’re fully remote. We believe great work happens when people have the freedom to work in the way that works best for them. We trust our team to set their own schedules, do their best work, and get the job done without micromanagement.
  • Unlimited PTO + US holidays. Work-life balance is one of GMP’s core values, and we genuinely live by it. Take the time you need to recharge and enjoy life outside of work.
  • Great healthcare benefits. Choose from a variety of medical plans with dependent coverage, plus dental and vision benefits.
  • 401 (k) retirement planning. GMP offers a 401(k) plan with employer contribution, helping you build long-term financial security while you build your career.

  • Make a real impact. Join a fast-growing startup where your work isn’t just another task on a list—you’ll have a meaningful opportunity to shape the direction and success of the business.
Salary: $85,000 – $125,000 / year
