jobs.excerpt: About the ClientWe’re helping a boutique professional services and advisory firm based in Nassau, The Bahamas find a Financial Analyst to support its growing portfolio of clients.
jobs.description:
About the Client

We’re helping a boutique professional services and advisory firm based in Nassau, The Bahamas find a Financial Analyst to support its growing portfolio of clients.

The firm works with entrepreneurs, established businesses, institutions, and international clients across strategic and financial advisory, corporate services, accounting and bookkeeping, back-office administration, and project management. Its clients span a variety of industries, including healthcare, professional services, government, and other service-based businesses.

The Role

We’re looking for a Financial Analyst – Accounting & Advisory to support the financial reporting, analysis, and research that underpin the firm's strategic advisory work.

The role sits at the intersection of accounting operations, financial analysis, and advisory support. You’ll work across multiple client businesses, preparing and analyzing P&Ls, balance sheets, cash flow statements, monthly financial packs, and straightforward forecasts while ensuring the senior advisory team has accurate and well-structured financial information to work from.

This is not primarily a valuation or complex financial modeling role. Instead, you'll develop a strong understanding of the financial operations of different businesses and turn their numbers into useful insights and structured outputs that support strategic decision-making.

There may also be research, commercial analysis, and project work depending on the needs of each client. As you develop, there is an opportunity to become increasingly involved in the strategic advisory side of the business.

Role Details

Commitment: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Working Hours: Bahamas working hours

Location: Fully Remote

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Start Date: ASAP

Monthly Rate: $1,800-$2,400 (can be higher, depending on level of experience)

What You’ll Do

Financial Reporting & Accounting Support

  • Prepare and maintain P&Ls, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and other financial reports across multiple client accounts.

  • Prepare recurring monthly financial and management reporting packs using established templates and processes.

  • Review and organize financial information to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

  • Analyze financial performance and identify relevant trends, movements, discrepancies, and areas requiring attention.

  • Support the financial back-office requirements of non-finance businesses across different industries.

  • Maintain well-organized financial information and supporting documentation across client accounts.

  • Learn and work with client-specific accounting systems, processes, and proprietary software where required.

Forecasting & Financial Analysis

  • Prepare and maintain straightforward financial forecasts and projections.

  • Support cash flow planning and other forward-looking financial analysis.

  • Analyze historical and current financial performance to help inform business decisions.

  • Assist with financial analysis relating to commercial credit, loan financing, and other business requirements where needed.

  • Translate financial data into clear and structured information for senior team members.

  • Flag unusual movements, inconsistencies, or areas that warrant further investigation.

The modeling requirements for this role are relatively straightforward. You won't be expected to build complex valuation or transaction models; the emphasis is on strong financial fundamentals, accurate reporting, practical forecasting, and understanding what the numbers mean for the business.

Strategic Advisory & Research Support

  • Prepare financial information and analysis used by senior team members in client-facing strategic advisory work.

  • Conduct business, financial, market, or industry research where required for client assignments.

  • Gather and structure information needed to support strategic recommendations.

  • Help turn financial and research findings into clear reports, presentations, and other client-facing materials.

  • Support senior team members with ad hoc analysis for different business challenges and opportunities.

  • Develop an understanding of each client's business model, operations, and commercial environment rather than looking at financial information in isolation.

Client & Project Support

  • Work across multiple client accounts and adapt to different industries, business models, and reporting requirements.

  • Support project coordination, documentation, and follow-up across advisory engagements.

  • Manage recurring deliverables and ensure financial information is prepared accurately and on time.

  • Assist with broader analytical and administrative requirements connected to client projects.

  • Take increasing ownership of client work as your understanding and capabilities develop.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves

  • Ideally 3–5 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, accounting, FP&A, management reporting, corporate services, or a similar finance-focused environment. However, practical capability is more important to us than a specific number of years.

  • Academic background in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of P&Ls, balance sheets, and cash flow statements and how they work together.

  • Hands-on experience preparing and analyzing financial reports and management information.

  • Comfortable preparing straightforward forecasts and financial projections.

  • Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong spreadsheet skills and confidence working with financial data.

  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

  • Ability to identify trends, inconsistencies, and relevant insights from financial information.

  • Ability to work across multiple clients, assignments, and deadlines.

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables, and recognize when issues need to be escalated.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in professional services, corporate consultancy, accounting, FP&A, or financial advisory.

  • Experience supporting multiple external client accounts.

  • Experience working with SMEs or service-based businesses.

  • Exposure to healthcare, medical, dental, government, or other professional-services clients.

  • Understanding of commercial lending, loan financing, or credit analysis.

  • Experience preparing management reports and financial projections.

  • Previous exposure to strategic advisory or consulting projects.

  • Experience conducting business, market, or industry research.

  • Experience managing or supporting financial back-office operations for non-finance businesses.

  • Experience working across multiple industries.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You’re someone who is strong with numbers but also interested in the business behind them.

You can confidently work with P&Ls, balance sheets, and cash flows, prepare reliable financial reporting, maintain forecasts, and spot when something doesn’t look right. At the same time, you’re curious about why the numbers are moving and what they mean for the business.

You may come from accounting, FP&A, financial analysis, consulting, or even a more traditional financial analyst background. What matters most is that you're comfortable with the practical financial work involved and genuinely interested in supporting businesses across a range of financial and strategic challenges.

This could also be a good fit for someone with a more modeling- or transaction-oriented finance background who is looking to move into a role with less emphasis on complex modeling and transactions and greater exposure to ongoing business operations and strategic advisory.

You’re organized, adaptable, commercially curious, and comfortable switching between financial reporting, forecasting, research, and project work across different client engagements.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means becoming a reliable extension of the advisory team who can independently manage high-quality financial preparation and analysis across multiple clients.

You’ll progressively reduce the financial preparation required from senior team members by ensuring reports, financial packs, forecasts, research, and supporting information are accurate, well-structured, and ready for use in strategic discussions.

As your understanding of the clients and advisory work develops, there will be opportunities to take on greater responsibility across financial analysis, research, strategic advisory, and project support.

Why Join?

  • Gain exposure to the financial operations and strategic challenges of multiple businesses and industries.

  • Work closely with experienced professionals on real-world client advisory engagements.

  • Build experience beyond traditional accounting or financial reporting into research and strategic advisory.

  • Take meaningful ownership of client work rather than being limited to one narrow finance function.

  • Develop a broader understanding of how financial information supports business strategy and decision-making.

  • Opportunity to grow into greater advisory and project responsibilities over time.

  • Join a fully remote team with a long-term opportunity for professional development.

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview with Bamboo Works

  2. Client Interview

  3. Practical Financial Assessment for Finalists

  4. Offer & Onboarding

The practical assessment will take place after the client interview stage and will only be completed by final shortlisted candidates.

About OLX

OLX is a global leader in facilitating trade. It builds leading marketplace ecosystems enabled by tech, powered by trust, and loved by customers.

Serving tens of millions of people every month around the world, OLX helps people buy and sell cars, find housing, get jobs, buy and sell household goods, and much more. Its well-loved consumer brands (including OLX, Otomoto, Property24, and more) offer safe, smart, and convenient online trading platforms and services for its customers.

OLX is powered by global teams, united in a common purpose to build a more sustainable world through trade. For more information, visit .

OLX is backed by Prosus, a global consumer internet group and one of the largest technology investors in the world. Prosus has a primary listing on Euronext Amsterdam (AEX:PRX) and a secondary listing on the JSE Limited (XJSE:PRX), and is majority-owned by Naspers. For more information on Prosus and its companies and investments, please visit .

The Opportunity

OLX is looking for an experienced and hands-on Product Director to lead product function for our core horizontal marketplace, spanning household goods, electronics, and other general merchandise categories. This is a global role with responsibility for the strategy and execution of Horizontal across a focused set of European markets. You'll be a key voice shaping how this business grows within the broader OLX portfolio.

You'll lead a product organization of around 15 people, working closely with engineering, design, and commercial leadership to define and deliver a product roadmap that drives growth, engagement, and monetization for both consumers and sellers on the platform.

This role reports to Michael Bullion, Chief Product Officer.

What You'll Do

  • Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Horizontal, in partnership with the CPO and broader leadership team.

  • Drive customer-centric product innovation with a focus on growth, retention, and monetization across the buyer and seller journeys.

  • Lead AI transformation for the horizontal domain

  • Lead the incubation, development & transition to a fully agentic horizontal marketplace.

  • Lead a product organization of around 15 people, with an emphasis on strong product management fundamentals — experimentation, documentation, and upstream opportunity discovery.

  • Work closely with engineering and commercial teams across markets to align product development with business priorities.

  • Identify and execute strategic opportunities, including creative monetization levers, cross-market improvements, and long-term category positioning.

  • Establish and scale best practices in product thinking and execution across your teams.

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of product managers and product leaders.

  • Partner with senior stakeholders across finance, commercial, and other functions to build consensus around strategy and priorities.

  • Act as a thought partner and sparring peer to other product and business leaders in shaping the future of OLX.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience leading product teams in online B2C/B2B2C environments, ideally in marketplaces, e-commerce, or classifieds. Experience navigating the dynamics of two-sided marketplaces (consumer buyers and sellers).

  • Strong hands-on product management background—not just a strategic leader, but someone who has built products and worked closely with engineers and commercial stakeholders.

  • Several years of experience hiring, growing, and directly managing Product Managers at all stages of their careers, ideally leading teams of a similar size (~15 people).

  • Comfort working in cross-functional, multicultural teams across multiple markets.

  • Strategic thinker, able to balance long-term vision with short- and medium-term goals.

  • Experience in both 0->1 and scaling phases of product development.

  • Proven track record of jumping between domains and sectors. Ability to learn fast.

  • Experience in developing and managing AI-based products.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX

At OLX, we are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. We strongly encourage people of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply.

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Business Intelligence Analyst.

About the job

This position is needed to provide actionable insights into strategic operations initiatives through the application of your expertise in quantitative analysis, technical systems, and leadership in analytics.

Twilio’s Customer Experience Ops Customer Intelligence team is looking for a curious and action-oriented analyst with a passion for using data to influence decision making and deliver product insights. The ideal candidate is comfortable navigating complex problems, determining the right data to focus on and is able to derive insights and recommendations based on disparate data. This role interacts with stakeholders at all levels throughout the organization and helps inform product, compliance, and delivery strategy.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Work with technical program managers to inject data into decision making and planning to increase confidence in strategic business outcomes via defining OKRs, designing and building insight generating reports and dashboards, and partnering cross functionally to source and process product data.
  • Leverage SQL programming skills and data visualization tools to communicate product insights and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels. Standardize, maintain, and document metrics, models, datasets, and dashboards leveraging tools such as Tableau, Confluence, Acryl, and code.
  • Source, identify, and leverage data and insights for time-critical and strategic decision making.
  • Partner with leaders to successfully roll out and enable the adoption of dashboards and metrics.
  • Work closely with product leadership to monitor and improve product performance while collaborating with business leaders to drive exceptional product offerings. Measure and analyze product value and value proposition through metrics.
  • Collaborate with data producers and consumers during the product development lifecycle to ensure consistent data quality and availability for reporting post launch.
  • Own and foster stakeholder partnerships by acting as a trusted advisor.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 3-5 years of professional experience performing quantitative analysis, building dashboards and reports, working with business partners to convert ambiguous, messy data into tangible and actionable results that influence product and business impacting decisions in a fast paced industry.
  • Ability to think strategically and initiate, refine, and complete projects with minimal guidance in an often ambiguous environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficient level experience writing, developing, and performing data deep dives and writing complex queries in SQL and SQL-like relational data languages
  • Minimum 2 years Tableau experience developing and managing dashboards is required.
  • Demonstrated ability in building reports, metrics, dashboards, etc. for analytics projects that often require data preparation processes such as data extraction, cleansing, mapping, loading and operationalizing workflows in production.

Desired:

  • Familiarity or hands-on experience utilizing Generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to optimize SQL query writing, data analysis workflows, and documentation is a plus.
  • Experience in telephony, email, messaging, social media, or other electronic communications is a plus.
  • Experience or familiarity with data warehousing and/or ETL processes, and distributed computing technologies (Hive/Presto/Spark/Zeppelin) is a plus.
  • Experience in BI reporting tools like Looker is a plus.
  • Experience with unstructured data is a plus.

Location

This role will be Remote, and based in Colombia

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

jobs.description:
Social Media Manager

About BlackBox Strategies

BlackBox Strategies is a revenue execution agency that leverages brand building, storytelling and digital presence to deliver more revenue on behalf of our clients.

Position: Social Media Manager

Location

Remote | Open to global candidates

Role Overview

BlackBox Strategies is seeking a proactive, results-oriented Social Media Manager to fully own and drive the performance of client's social media channels. You will be responsible for setting the strategy, defining the content roadmap, and overseeing execution across all key platforms. This role demands a creative and analytical leader who can identify content needs, coordinate with copywriters, designers, and marketing teams, and ensure the delivery of engaging, high-performing content.

As the Social Media Manager, you will shape our online brand presence and the digital voice of our clients, leading efforts to grow audiences, increase engagement, and drive measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take end-to-end ownership of all social media channels for BlackBox Strategies and select clients, ensuring their ongoing growth and impact

  • Define and implement comprehensive social media strategies to engage target audiences and achieve brand and revenue goals

  • Develop and maintain an actionable content calendar, clearly identifying the types of content needed to meet growth and engagement objectives

  • Proactively leverage AI tools and platforms to generate, enhance, and optimize social content

  • Collaborate and coordinate with cross-functional teams—including creative, copy, design, and marketing—to source and deliver best-in-class content on deadline

  • Curate, schedule, and publish high-impact content across LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter, and other relevant platforms

  • Monitor and analyze performance metrics, proactively refining tactics to optimize reach, engagement, and conversion rates

  • Actively engage with online communities, respond to comments/messages, and foster brand advocacy across all channels

  • Stay current with industry trends, social tools (including the latest advances in AI-assisted content), and algorithm changes, proposing and testing innovative approaches

  • Nurture relationships with influencers and partners to extend campaign reach and impact

Requirements

  • 5+ years' experience managing and growing branded social media channels (agency or multi-client exposure preferred)

  • Proven track record of driving measurable performance and audience growth across multiple platforms

  • Strategic content planner with strong copywriting and storytelling skills

  • Proficient in major social media management and analytics tools (e.g., Hootsuite, Buffer, Sprout Social, Later, etc.)

  • Experience in working collaboratively with creative teams to deliver on-brand visual and written content

  • Skilled in basic design or video editing; motion/animation experience a plus

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, derive insights, and continually improve

  • Organized self-starter able to juggle multiple projects and deadlines effectively

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation

  • Flexible, remote work environment

  • Opportunity to make a visible impact on brand and revenue growth

  • Work with a fast-moving, creative team dedicated to excellence

  • Continuous learning, development, and cross-functional collaboration

jobs.description:
CMS

Die ZOLL Medical Corporation trägt als eines der weltweit führenden Unternehmen im Bereich Medizinprodukte und Softwarelösungen dazu bei, Leben zu retten. Unser Geschäftsbereich Cardiac Management Solutions (CMS) entwickelt Produkte zum Schutz und zur Behandlung von Herzpatienten. Dazu gehört unsere tragbare Kardioverter-Defibrillator-Weste (WCD), die LifeVest®. Bis heute wurde die LifeVest® weltweit von Hunderttausenden Patienten getragen und hat Tausende Leben gerettet. Wir alle tragen mit unserer Arbeit bei ZOLL CMS dazu bei, dass Herzpatienten diese lebensrettende Therapie erhalten.

Unsere Mission: „Mehr Leben retten!“

Dazu suchen wir zur Verstärkung unseres Vertriebs-/ Außendienst-Teams eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die uns ab dem 01.12.2026 als

Gebietsleiter / Territory Manager (m/w/d) Nürnberg im Bereich Medizintechnik

Gebiete: Nürnberg, Fürth, Erlangen, Bamberg, Bayreuth & Coburg

in Vollzeit / unbefristet

mit Leidenschaft, Überzeugungskraft und Verantwortungsbewusstsein unterstützen, die Versorgung von Herzpatientinnen und Herzpatienten nachhaltig zu verbessern.

Das sind Ihre Aufgaben:

  • Sie steuern und entwickeln Ihr Vertriebsgebiet eigenverantwortlich und treiben den nachhaltigen Ausbau aktiv voran.
  • Sie begleiten anspruchsvolle Entscheidungsprozesse in Kliniken und beraten Ärztinnen, Ärzte sowie medizinisches Fachpersonal auf Augenhöhe.
  • Sie entwickeln belastbare Beziehungen zu relevanten Key Accounts, Meinungsbildnern und Entscheidungsträgern im kardiologischen Umfeld.
  • Sie identifizieren Versorgungslücken und setzen gezielt Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Patientenversorgung um.
  • Gemeinsam mit Ihrem Regionalleiter entwickeln Sie individuelle, Vertriebsstrategien und setzen diese eigenständig um.
  • Im Tandem mit einem Klinischen Anwendungsspezialisten sorgen Sie für eine optimale Einführung und Anwendung unserer Therapie im klinischen Alltag.
  • Sie planen und moderieren Fortbildungen sowie Round-Table-Veranstaltungen und stehen als kompetenter Partner für fachlichen Austausch zur Verfügung.
  • Sie repräsentieren ZOLL und die LifeVest® auf nationalen und internationalen, Messen, Kongressen und Fachveranstaltungen.

Das bringen Sie mit:

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im naturwissenschaftlichen oder kaufmännischen Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit relevanter Berufserfahrung in der Medizintechnik oder Pharmaindustrie.
  • Alternativ eine Ausbildung im medizinischen Umfeld, beispielsweise als examinierte Pflegekraft oder Fachpflegekraft für Intensiv- und Anästhesiepflege.
  • Ein sicheres Auftreten, Kommunikationsstärke und unternehmerisches Denken.
  • Begeisterung für den Vertrieb sowie eine hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung.
  • Freude daran, Beziehungen aufzubauen und langfristig erfolgreich zu gestalten.

Das bieten wir Ihnen:

  • Eine besondere Mission, die als Team verbindet und Leben rettet.
  • Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum im dynamischen und wachsenden Medizintechnikmarkt.
  • Einen Premium-Dienstwagen, den Sie auch privat nutzen können.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie 30 Tage Urlaub.
  • Umfangreiche Trainings- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten für Ihre fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung.
  • Ein innovatives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Sie Verantwortung übernehmen und aktiv zum Unternehmenserfolg beitragen können.
  • Zahlreiche Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung, Sport- und Wellnessangebote, Employee Assistance Program, Corporate Benefits sowie außergewöhnliche Mitarbeiterevents.
  • Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung durch Ihr Team sowie spannende Basistrainings in unserem Kölner Office.

Gemeinsam mehr Leben retten!

Wenn Sie Teil unserer Mission werden möchten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung über unsere Karriereseite.

Für Ihre Bewerbung benötigen wir lediglich Ihren Lebenslauf. Ein Anschreiben oder weitere Unterlagen sind nicht erforderlich, können aber gerne zusätzlich eingereicht werden.

Noch unsicher? Bewerben Sie sich trotzdem.

Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbungen von Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten, die nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllen oder neue Wege gehen möchten.

Italic is hiring a Business Development & Partnerships Manager in Shenzhen to identify and work with Chinese brands that want to enter the U.S. market, with Italic acting as their U.S. distributor. This role owns outreach, qualification, relationship management, commercial discussion, sample coordination, and the handoff from promising brand lead to active partnership.

We are looking for someone with 3-5 years of BD, partnerships, sales, channel, retail, e-commerce, brand, or distribution experience. The right person is proactive, commercially sharp, organized, and comfortable moving between Chinese brand teams and a U.S.-market strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Source, contact, and follow up with Chinese consumer brands that may be a fit for U.S. market entry through Italic.

  • Explain Italic's U.S. distribution and market-entry opportunity clearly to founders, brand teams, factories, and channel partners.

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of target brands, contacts, follow-up status, samples, commercial terms, and next steps.

  • Discuss early partnership terms, including product scope, supply capacity, pricing, channel restrictions, market support, and U.S. distribution needs.

  • Coordinate internal review of brand and product opportunities across product quality, pricing, supply reliability, packaging, compliance risk, and U.S. market fit.

  • Own the full early-stage BD workflow from outbound outreach and first calls to sample collection, materials review, commercial discussion, and partnership handoff.

  • Track market and brand intelligence across Chinese consumer brands, cross-border e-commerce, DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and retail channels.

  • Keep the Shenzhen and U.S. teams aligned with clear updates on progress, risks, blockers, and decisions needed.

Requirements

  • Based in Shenzhen and able to meet brands, suppliers, trade-show contacts, and partners in person.

  • 3-5 years of experience in BD, partnerships, sales, channel partnerships, brand partnerships, marketplace development, retail, e-commerce, consumer brands, cross-border commerce, or distribution.

  • Experience proactively sourcing and developing customers or partners from initial outreach through follow-up and next-step execution.

  • Good understanding of the challenges Chinese brands face when entering the U.S. market, including positioning, channel strategy, pricing, packaging, compliance, inventory, and trust.

  • Clear communicator who can make Italic's partnership model feel concrete and credible.

  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to quickly assess whether a brand is worth pursuing.

  • Organized enough to manage a large volume of leads, contacts, and partnership conversations over time.

  • Fluent Mandarin and strong written English; spoken business English is a plus.

Helpful but Not Required

  • Experience with cross-border e-commerce, Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, overseas distribution, or U.S. retail channels.

  • Experience at a consumer brand, trading company, marketplace, channel sales team, or brand agency.

  • Familiarity with brand, supply-chain, or trade-show networks in Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Dongguan, Yiwu, Hangzhou, or similar cities.

  • Experience with brand internationalization, U.S. market entry, distribution agreements, channel partnerships, or commercial negotiation.

  • Ability to manage a lead pipeline clearly in a CRM, spreadsheet, or similar workflow tool.

jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Neobank App.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native Android features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Turn complex financial flows into simple, fast and reliable mobile experiences.

  • Work closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take features from idea to production.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve what you build after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native Android experience using Kotlin.

  • Experience shipping Android apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android development.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just screens and tickets.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Thailand. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Thailand.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Engineering escalation- create well-documented engineering tickets where required and tag the appropriate teams

Install validation- assist the deployment teams to confirm hardware is online and correctly set up post-install in coordination.

Device monitoring- check device online/offline status, flag anomalies, and take defined first-response actions

Direct, transparent communicator who escalates early, brings solutions with the problem, and wants teammates who operate the same way

Healthcare or senior living familiarity- willingness to learn Teton's clinical context quickly

Prior experience at an early-stage SaaS or healthcare technology company

Prior experience working a shift-based or follow-the-sun support schedule, including weekend rotations

401(k) plan, paid time off, health insurance.

A day in the Client Engineer role:

You might open a conversation with a client who wants to evaluate a new business intelligence platform. You'll work through what they're trying to accomplish, assess the hosting and infrastructure implications, identify where it touches identity or compliance, and produce a structured recommendation even if Sentinel Blue won't own the full implementation. That same week, you might be standing up the server infrastructure to host it, working through a configuration issue blocking a data connection, or troubleshooting why an integration with their identity provider isn't behaving as expected.   • Assess unfamiliar systems and platforms quickly, understanding hosting requirements, integration dependencies, security posture, and compliance implications even without deep prior experience with the specific tool.
  • Deploy, configure, and troubleshoot infrastructure and applications as part of client engagements, including standing up servers, modifying system configurations, and resolving application-level issues.
  • Provide guidance aligned with CMMC, NIST 800-171, and CIS Controls as applicable to client context.
  • Identify gaps, risks, and remediation priorities across client environments and communicate them clearly.
  • Help clients evaluate vendor proposals and technology investments, including RFP support, contract review from a technical lens, and total cost of ownership analysis.

  • Experience engaging with compliance frameworks such as CMMC, NIST 800-171, or CIS Controls in a practical engineering or advisory context.

jobs.description:
Champion AI is the strategic future of QAD | Redzone, and we are building a dedicated AI division to own it — this is where the company’s attention, investment, and ambition are concentrated. The strategy and the technical foundation are built; we need solution designers who can execute it and scale it across customers.

There has never been a better moment to sit at the frontier of agentic AI for manufacturing. We are assembling a small team of operators to capture it, and this role helps define what “great” looks like.

The Role

The AI Account Executive & Sales Solutions Engineer is a solution designer. You walk into a customer conversation, understand their end-to-end process, and assemble an agentic solution to fix it — without engineering involvement.

You sit on top of a pre-built foundation — data, semantics, an agent platform, and a library of persona agents. You configure within it; you don’t build it. The platform exposes configuration through natural language and drag-and-drop, so your edge is domain fluency and solution-design instinct, not code.

What You’ll Do

Working hand-in-hand with other Account Executives, you take a qualified opportunity and turn it into a working agentic solution:

  • Run process discovery workshops: sit with champion users to map any of the standard enterprise processes (P2P, S2C, O2C, P2M, F2P, R2R) — current state, KPIs, manual effort, bottlenecks, and target state.
  • Design the agentic solution: decide which agents, working together, fix the customer’s process — and recognize whether it’s a greenfield build or a brownfield plug-in to an existing system (SAP, Ariba, Coupa, Jaggaer).
  • Map KPIs to the platform: confirm the system has the data and the business context to measure what the customer actually cares about.
  • Configure each agent: set triggers, decision logic, exceptions, KPIs, data sources, communications, company-specific rules, and hand-offs — all in natural language and drag-and-drop, no code.
  • Present the solution: pitch anchored in business outcomes — OTIF, working capital, cycle time, cost reduction — worked backwards to the agents that achieve them.
  • You are a quota carrier with 3 or more years of experience selling Tech/AI/SaaS solutions.
  • Enterprise domain fluency: operational, end-to-end working knowledge of at least two of P2P, S2C, O2C, P2M, F2P, R2R — not just a consulting view. The deepest value sits in plan-to-make and procure-to-pay.
  • Solution-design thinking: ability to decompose a vague business outcome into agents and data flows, and to know when one agent suffices and when several are needed.
  • Low-code / natural-language comfort: hands-on with tools like n8n, Zapier, or Make. The agent platform will feel familiar.
  • Customer-facing credibility: workshop facilitation and executive-level presentation.

Nice-to-Have

  • Background at a major ERP vendor or process consultancy (SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Ariba, or a Big Four firm).
  • Hands-on experience with AI tooling.
  • Industry depth in manufacturing, particularly tier-one suppliers.

Not Required

Model-building, software-engineering depth, or an ML / data-science background. Engineering owns the platform; you own the solution.

Who Thrives Here

  • You are joining a small, entrepreneurial team — not a delivery machine with a ticket queue. We want self-starters who see the opportunity in agentic AI and move without waiting for instructions.
  • Self-starter: if a solution pattern or workshop framework doesn’t exist yet, you create it. If a document is missing, you write it.
  • Resourceful: you pull in the right people — your AE, Product, and Customer Success — to move a deal forward and get the customer to value.
  • Builder’s mindset: you take a strong foundation and a playbook and extend them as the platform matures, rather than waiting for every process to be defined for you.
  • If you need rigid structure and a clearly defined process for every situation, this is not the right place. If you want to shape how this role and this division are built, it is.
  • Compensation. $100,000— 140,000 USD ,
  • Plus a strong benefits package inclusive of PTO, 401K matching, and Healthcare/Medical Insurance plans.
  • Virtual-First Culture: work remotely, with the flexibility to lead in-person customer workshops in your market.
  • Atmosphere of Growth: join a team where idea-sharing is prioritized over hierarchy, at the leading edge of agentic AI for manufacturing.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: health, dental, vision, PTO, 401K matching, and a collaborative culture of smart, hard-working people.

About QAD:

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

jobs.title: Vice President of Communications and Narrative Strategy
jobs.excerpt: The Proportional Representation HubAmerican democracy is at a breaking point.
jobs.description:
The Proportional Representation Hub

American democracy is at a breaking point. Across the country, voters increasingly find themselves throwing up their hands and turning away from a failing political system. Hyper-partisanship has become entrenched. Fewer than one in ten House races is competitive, and 97% of incumbents cruise to reelection: for most voters, the outcome was settled before a single ballot was cast. Little wonder that politicians feel little pressure to deliver legislative results. Public trust in democratic institutions continues to erode as more and more voters tune out.

But the problem isn’t the politicians. It’s the rules. U.S. elections are distorted by single-winner, winner-take-all districts. A party can win 45% of the vote in districts across a state yet it wins no power. The Supreme Court’s evisceration of the Voting Rights Act has made things much worse: voters in communities of color are being carved up and packed into districts engineered to drown out their voices, and the court has triggered a redistricting death spiral. The need for structural reform has never been more urgent.

There is a fix, and most of the world already uses it: proportional representation. The idea is simple––districts elect several members, and a party that wins a third of the votes wins about a third of the seats. It breaks the two-party monopoly, makes every district competitive, eliminates partisan gerrymandering, and reduces polarization.

The Proportional Representation Hub has launched to help build the next chapter of American democracy. We have raised more than $70 million to lead a campaign to advance proportional representation at the local, state, and federal levels and build a government that delivers again. Proportional representation is the best path to create a democracy that better reflects the diversity of the American people, and the best path to end the redistricting wars.

This work is ambitious: forging unlikely coalitions, winning new legislation and ballot measures, changing public narratives, and developing innovative political strategies. Above all, it demands a cross-partisan movement big enough to persuade the huge majority of Americans who say the political system no longer works for them that our democracy can work far better than it does today.

We are building a team of exceptional leaders working together to reshape the architecture of American democracy itself.

Position Overview

The Vice President of Communications and Narrative Strategy will build and lead the communications, research, and narrative infrastructure necessary to make proportional representation one of the defining democracy reform movements of the 21st century.

The Vice President of Communications and Narrative Strategy will lead all communications, narrative development, public opinion research, digital engagement, media relations, and strategic communications efforts for the Proportional Representation Hub.

This executive will be responsible for shaping how policymakers, voters, journalists, funders, advocates, and opinion leaders understand proportional representation, in the context of other democracy reforms. They will oversee the communications strategies supporting federal, state, and local campaigns while simultaneously building a long-term narrative change effort to help transform the national conversation about democracy and move the idea of proportional representation from the margins to the mainstream.

The Vice President will oversee communications consultants, research firms, polling vendors, creative agencies, digital partners, media strategists, and public affairs consultants. They will also help build communications capacity throughout the broader democracy reform ecosystem, providing strategic guidance and technical support to allied organizations and campaign partners.

The Vice President of Communications and Narrative Strategy will serve as a member of the Senior Leadership Team.

This is a role for a visionary strategist, storyteller, communicator, and movement builder who understands that political change begins with narrative change.

What You’ll Lead

Build a Narrative for Democratic Reform and a Message for Proportional Representation

  • Develop and execute a long-term narrative strategy for multiparty electoral reform and redefine the public conversation about representation, accountability, fairness, and democratic legitimacy.
  • Create messaging frameworks that make proportional representation understandable, compelling, and that resonate across ideological, geographic, racial, and generational divides. Translate complex policy reforms into accessible, motivating narratives that inspire action and support. Ensure campaign communications consistently advance both immediate policy goals and long-term narrative and movement-building objectives.

Lead Narrative Intelligence and Opposition Analysis

  • Build a narrative intelligence operation that continuously tracks public opinion, media narratives, opposition messaging, cultural trends, and emerging political opportunities.
  • Identify threats, attacks, misinformation campaigns, and opposition arguments before they become obstacles to campaign success, and develop proactive communications strategies that inoculate target audiences against predictable attacks and mischaracterizations.
  • Lead ongoing analysis of the political, media, and advocacy landscape to identify opportunities to expand support for proportional representation.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to the Executive Director and leadership team on reputational risks, emerging opportunities, and changing political conditions.

Drive Winning Campaign Communications

  • Lead communications strategy for federal, state, and local campaigns across the organization’s portfolio.
  • Develop integrated communications plans that leverage earned media, paid media, digital engagement, thought leadership, coalition communications, grassroots storytelling, and public affairs strategies.
  • Ensure campaigns have compelling messaging, rapid response capabilities, media strategies, research support, and public engagement plans.
  • Provide communications strategy, message guidance, narrative support, and technical assistance to allied organizations and coalition partners to support thought leadership across the movement. Create shared tools, research products, messaging resources, narrative frameworks, and strategic guidance that can be deployed by partners nationwide.
  • Build and train a bench of spokespeople and champions for proportional representation, diverse across multiple dimensions including ideologically, and place their voices in traditional and new media channels.
  • Build strong relationships with journalists, editorial boards, influencers, content creators, podcast hosts, and opinion leaders.

Oversee Research and Message Development

  • Lead all public opinion research with polling, focus groups, message testing, audience segmentation, narrative research, and voter insight efforts.
  • Work with leading research firms and strategists to deepen understanding of voter attitudes toward democracy, representation, and political reform.
  • Build systems that allow successful innovations and lessons learned in one campaign to strengthen efforts across the broader movement.

Build a Modern Digital and Media Program

  • Oversee all digital communications, content strategy, social media, paid media, influencer engagement, online organizing, audience growth efforts, and emerging communications platforms.
  • Develop innovative approaches to reach audiences beyond traditional political and advocacy channels.
  • Build a modern communications infrastructure capable of supporting persuasion, movement-building, and rapid-response objectives across federal, state, and local campaigns.

Who you are

You bring a proven track record of leading large-scale communications, public affairs, political, advocacy, or movement-building efforts that have shifted public opinion, shaped public narratives, and contributed to significant policy victories. You have demonstrated experience thinking strategically about the right messengers to the right audiences in the right channels.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of senior leadership experience in political communications, public affairs, advocacy, movement-building, media, narrative strategy, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated success leading communications efforts that shifted public opinion, shaped public narratives, influenced policymakers, or contributed to significant policy victories.
  • Deep expertise in message development, polling, audience research, media relations, digital communications, public affairs, and strategic communications planning.
  • Experience overseeing communications for complex, multi-state, national, or international campaigns.
  • Strong understanding of how narrative change contributes to long-term political and social change.
  • Experience managing communications firms, polling vendors, research partners, creative agencies, and large communications budgets.
  • Exceptional writing, storytelling, presentation, and strategic thinking skills.
  • Familiarity with campaign finance regulations (C3/C4 compliance).
  • Strong relationships within national media, digital media, political communications, philanthropy, or advocacy ecosystems.
  • Experience building and managing high-performing teams.
  • A deep commitment to strengthening American democracy and advancing representative government.

Equal Opportunity/Diversity Policy:

Proportional Representation Hub prohibits discrimination of employment, promotion, compensation, terms, conditions, or privileges of employment on the basis of race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, sex (including marital and parental status), religion, age, disability, actual or perceived gender identity or expression, weight, personal appearance, family responsibilities, genetic information, economic status, genetic information, veteran’s status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. Proportional Representation Hub is an equal opportunity employer and will comply with all applicable laws prohibiting discrimination in employment.

Compensation Details:

A person with fewer years of work experience living in a lower-cost metro area will earn in the bottom third of that range, while a person with more years of experience living in a higher-cost location will earn in the middle third of the range. The highest end of the range reflects the most work experience, the highest-cost metro areas, and more years at the Proportional Representation Hub.

The Proportional Representation Hub offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees professionally and personally. Benefits and perks Include:

About the Role

Odd Bunch has built one of the strongest growth engines in its affiliate and ambassador program, now our most efficient acquisition channel. We're launching in the US and scaling the program aggressively across all three markets.

We're looking for someone who has built this function rather than inherited one. You'll own the channel end to end: the revenue number, the economics underneath it, the creator roster that drives it, the content library it produces, and the offline activations that support it.

This is a player-coach role. You'll set the strategy and then execute it alongside a small team in a lean environment. The person who does well here is comfortable working in a cohort retention report and at a sampling activation in the same week.

What You'll Own

  • Program strategy and targets: own affiliate revenue as a number you're accountable for, alongside CPA discipline (currently a $25 to $30 band), payback period, and LTV. You'll set the targets and flag early when they need to change.
  • Unit economics: run the channel on contribution margin and LTV:CAC rather than last-click revenue. Understand cohort behaviour well enough to know which creators bring subscribers who retain and which bring subscribers who churn early, and shift spend accordingly.
  • Global go-to-market: lead the program across all three markets, covering creator sourcing, platforms (Roster, Upfluence, AWIN), gifting and PR, and partnerships. Heavy strategic focus on TikTok and TikTok Shop to drive US market entry.
  • Creator roster and lifecycle: build the progression from customer to ambassador to affiliate to top-tier creator. Own onboarding throughput, since time from first contact to first post largely determines how fast the channel can grow. Develop the mid-tail deliberately so revenue isn't concentrated in a handful of relationships.
  • Creative pipeline: treat the content the program generates as a core asset. Build the whitelisting and creator-asset pipeline that feeds paid social, and measure yourself on blended CAC impact alongside the affiliate line.
  • Product seeding and cross-sell: use creators to seed adjacent products, including our Pantry line, as a lower-friction entry point into the core subscription and as an AOV expander for existing subscribers. Build the loop where each product drives demand for the other rather than competing with it.
  • In-real-life events and activations: own the offline side of the program, including sampling, farmers markets, food and wellness festivals, community events, pop-ups, and retail activations. Run creator trips and creator-house programming that produces content at volume. These serve brand, acquisition and content goals together, and you'll be measured across all three.
  • Creator compensation: design and test compensation models, including commission, flat fee, guarantees and tiered leaderboards, that scale profitably. Own rate card discipline and negotiation across a large number of relationships.
  • Attribution and incrementality: own the affiliate stack (Upfluence, AWIN, Roster, Triple Whale) and understand its limits. Run holdouts and geo tests where it matters, and tell leadership when a channel is less incremental than reported.
  • Hands-on leadership: manage and work alongside the affiliate team, coaching through reporting and reliability gaps while carrying your own workload. On a team this size the strategist is also an operator.
  • Leadership reporting: deliver a data-backed weekly and bi-weekly narrative with insight and recommendations rather than raw status, including a clear point of view you're prepared to discuss.

  • Negotiate resolution of claims
  • Assist in the development, shaping, adherence to, and execution of best practices
  • Maintain vendors list for field investigators, appraiser’s, experts, fraud investigators and CAT alerts.
  • Maintain contact and oversight with the TPA claim staff
  • Work with underwriting on appetite selection, form development.
  • Identify and review of each jurisdiction's applicable statutes, rules, and case law
  • Analyze, and direct initial risk transfer, subrogation/salvage action, additional insured issues, and contractual indemnity issues, to ensure equitable contribution across all claim stakeholders
  • Retain counsel when necessary and direct counsel in accordance with resolution strategy
  • Prepare and present written/oral reports to senior management setting forth all issues influencing evaluation and recommending reserves
  • Travel to and from locations within the United States to attend mediations, trials, and other proceedings relevant to the resolution of the matter. Expected travel <5-10%

What we are looking for

  • Ability to work regular work the core hours of Monday-Friday 8:00am-5:00pm in your time zone. Additional off hours may be needed pending business needs.
  • 5-7 years of work experience at an insurance company and/or insurance claims loss adjustment service provider resolving property and casualty claims.

  • Exceptional communication (written and verbal), influencing, evaluation, negotiating, listening, and interpersonal skills to effectively develop productive working relationships with internal/external peers and other professionals across organizational lines
  • Strong time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to take part in active strategic discussions
  • Excellent collaboration skills, self-motivated and willing to take initiative
  • Able to understand and synthesize day-to-day work within the team into trends, themes, successes and opportunities over periods of time
  • Strong negotiation and persuasion abilities
  • Exceptional interpersonal and client service skills
  • Detail oriented and superior organizational skills
  • Team player with the ability to collaborate with others
  • Ability to work independently, with support, in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Hands-on experience and strong aptitude with Microsoft Office

  • Quality Assurance (QA), Continuous Process Improvement (CPI), User Experience (UX/UI), Design Thinking, Lean, Agile, Project Management (PM), and/or Product Owner (PO) experience
  • AIC and PTC designations a plus

Our interview process:
Our hiring process generally consists of 4 phases. The goal is to provide an opportunity for us to learn more about our candidates while allowing them to get to know us as well!

  • Phase 1: Qualified candidates will first meet with a member of our People Operations team for a phone interview. This discussion is a high-level conversation to understand more about your background and interests and for us to share more about Coterie and the position.
  • Phase 2: Selected candidates will be invited to meet with our Hiring Manager for a 2nd interview via Teams video. This interview is designed to be more detail oriented and allows you to learn more about the role and expected to be 30 minutes in length.
  • Phase 3:Top candidates will receive an invite for our final interview series via Teams video. This series will include an experiential exercise project (provided in advance) followed by a 1-hour panel interview with our claims team and a 1:1 interview with a member of our senior leadership team.   • 12 company-paid holidays each year
  • Annual salary estimated between 75,000-110,000 based on national data. Salary is based on internal equity; internal salary ranges; market data/ranges; applicant’s skills; prior relevant experience; degrees or certifications, etc.

About Elm AI

At Elm AI, we’re rebuilding supplier operations for an agent-first world.

We believe the next generation of enterprise software will not be passive systems of record. It will be made up of agents that stay live inside important workflows: understanding context, coordinating action, and keeping critical work moving across teams, suppliers, documents, systems, and decisions.

That is what Elm AI is building.

Our agents operate across responsible sourcing and supplier operations, helping companies manage audit review, corrective actions, supplier follow-through, remediation, scorecards, supplier portals, document review, and broader operational workflows that still run on spreadsheets, email, and manual coordination.

Elm is already live with major consumer brands, supporting supplier programs that span thousands of factories and some of the most operationally complex supply chains in the world.

Our ambition is much larger: to build the agent-first operating layer for how global supplier work gets done.

The Role

We’re hiring a Strategic Customer Success Manager to own high-value customer relationships and help customers deploy AI into real supply chain workflows.

This is not a traditional “check-in and renewal” customer success role.

You’ll work closely with sourcing, supply chain, responsible sourcing, compliance, and operations teams to understand how work actually gets done today: the SOPs, spreadsheets, handoffs, follow-ups, exceptions, dashboards, supplier communications, and recurring manual processes that keep supplier operations moving.

Then you’ll help turn those workflows into AI-powered systems that create measurable business value.

You’ll be part customer partner, part operator, part product thinker, and part solutions strategist. You should be comfortable sitting with a customer, unpacking a messy process, identifying where AI can create ROI, and working closely with our product and engineering team to bring that solution to life.

The ideal person is excited by startups, AI, enterprise software, and the practical reality of deploying technology into complex operational environments.

What You’ll Do

  • Own strategic customer relationships from onboarding through adoption, expansion, and renewal
  • Lead customers through deployment of Elm’s AI workflows across responsible sourcing and broader supplier operations
  • Map customer workflows, SOPs, pain points, data sources, and manual processes
  • Identify high-ROI opportunities where AI can reduce manual work, improve speed, increase visibility, or help teams do more with less
  • Translate customer needs into clear product, workflow, and implementation requirements
  • Partner closely with engineering and product to shape deployments and improve the platform
  • Drive adoption across customer teams, including operators, program managers, executives, and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Build repeatable playbooks for onboarding, workflow discovery, rollout, value tracking, and expansion
  • Turn customer data, usage patterns, and operational context into clear recommendations
  • Help customers understand what AI can realistically do inside their supply chain operations
  • Surface expansion opportunities by understanding the broader operational problems customers are trying to solve
  • Help shape Elm’s customer success motion as we scale

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is energized by customers, technology, and ambiguity.

You may have a background in customer success, consulting, implementation, solutions, product, operations, or a similarly customer-facing role. What matters most is that you can understand complex workflows, earn trust with customers, and help turn messy operational problems into clear, high-value solutions.

You might be a strong fit if you have:

  • 3–7 years of experience in customer success, consulting, implementation, solutions, product, operations, or a related role
  • Experience working with technical or enterprise software products
  • Strong interest in AI and how it changes business operations
  • Comfort working with customers to map workflows, diagnose problems, and define success metrics
  • Ability to speak with both operators and executives
  • Strong program management instincts and excellent follow-through
  • Data fluency: you can interpret dashboards, spot patterns, and translate findings into recommendations
  • A high degree of ownership and comfort operating without perfect structure

- Clear written and verbal communication

  • Curiosity about supply chains, sourcing, manufacturing, compliance, logistics, procurement, or supplier operations

Bonus Points

Not required, but helpful:

  • Experience in supply chain, sourcing, procurement, logistics, manufacturing, ESG, responsible sourcing, or compliance

- Experience at an early-stage startup

  • Experience in solutions engineering, implementation, or forward-deployed customer work
  • Comfort with technical concepts such as APIs, data models, workflows, integrations, or AI agents
  • Experience working with global teams across the U.S., Europe, and Asia
  • Experience selling, deploying, or supporting AI-native products

The Kind of Person Who Tends to Thrive at Elm AI

The people who thrive here are usually curious, high-agency, and a little averse to inefficient processes.

They like getting close to the customer. They ask good questions. They want to understand the actual work behind the process: who does it, why it exists, where it breaks, what it costs, and what would happen if it worked 10x better.

They are excited by AI, but they are not hand-wavy about it. They care about practical outcomes: hours saved, processes accelerated, exceptions resolved, decisions improved, and teams able to do more with less.

They don’t need a perfect playbook before moving. They help create the playbook.

They are comfortable in the messy middle between customer conversations, product strategy, implementation details, and business value. They can zoom out to an executive narrative and zoom in to a spreadsheet, SOP, or workflow diagram.

They care deeply about customers, but they also care about building a company that can scale.

Why This Role

- High ownership from day one

  • Direct exposure to founders, customers, product, and strategy
  • The chance to help define a new category of AI-native supply chain software
  • Work with major global brands on real operational problems
  • A role that can grow into customer success, solutions, implementation, or go-to-market leadership
  • Several years of runway, backed by top investors
  • A team that is ambitious, technical, thoughtful, and moving quickly

Working Style & Time Overlap

This role is remote, but requires meaningful overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.

You should be comfortable working primarily in EST hours, with flexibility to accommodate customers across Europe and Asia when needed.

Perks & Support

- Competitive compensation

  • High-trust, high-ownership work environment

- Learning and development budget

- Generous AI and tooling budget

  • Personal spend card for experimentation, software, education, or anything that helps you learn and work better
  • A culture that supports sustainable work, both in how we operate and how we build the business
