jobs.excerpt: Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO)About the RoleWe are seeking an accomplished and strategically minded Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO) to lead the financial strategy, performance, capital management, investment finance, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investments Group.
jobs.description:
Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and strategically minded Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO) to lead the financial strategy, performance, capital management, investment finance, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investments Group.

The Group CFO will have enterprise-wide responsibility for the Group's financial affairs, overseeing finance across subsidiaries, business units, investment entities, and operating companies.

As a key member of the Group Executive Leadership Team, the Group CFO will serve as a strategic advisor to the Group CEO, President, Board, Investment Committee, and other senior stakeholders, ensuring disciplined capital allocation, strong financial performance, balance-sheet resilience, regulatory compliance, and long-term shareholder value creation.

The role requires a sophisticated financial leader with experience across insurance, investment management, asset management, financial services, corporate finance, capital markets, and regulated financial institutions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Group Financial Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute the Group's overall financial strategy in alignment with corporate objectives.

Provide strategic financial advice to the Group CEO, President, Board, and Executive Committee.

Establish Group-wide financial policies, standards, controls, and performance frameworks.

Ensure effective financial governance across subsidiaries, business units, joint ventures, and investment entities.

Lead the development of the Group's long-term financial and capital strategy.

2. Group P&L & Financial Performance

Assume overall responsibility for the Group's financial performance, profitability, balance sheet, cash flow, and capital position.

Monitor performance across all subsidiaries and business lines.

Drive sustainable earnings growth, expense efficiency, and return on capital.

Establish Group-wide financial KPIs and performance dashboards.

Challenge business-unit leadership on financial performance and corrective actions.

3. Financial Planning & Performance Management

Lead Group-wide annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning.

Develop financial scenarios and stress tests to support strategic decision-making.

Consolidate financial plans across subsidiaries and investment businesses.

Monitor actual performance against budgets, forecasts, and strategic objectives.

Strengthen management reporting and financial analytics.

4. Insurance Finance

Provide executive oversight of financial management across insurance businesses.

Monitor premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, underwriting results, and insurance profitability.

Oversee financial analysis of loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting margins.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk functions to understand financial exposures.

Provide financial input into product profitability, pricing, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions.

5. Investment & Asset Management Finance

Provide Group-level financial oversight of investment portfolios and investment businesses.

Partner with the Chief Investment Officer (CIO) and Investment Committee on investment strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, portfolio returns, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted performance.

Evaluate strategic investment opportunities and major portfolio decisions.

Ensure investment activities support the Group's liabilities, capital objectives, liquidity needs, and risk appetite.

6. Group Capital & Solvency Management

Lead Group-wide capital planning and capital optimization.

Monitor capital adequacy, solvency, leverage, liquidity, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize capital deployment across subsidiaries and business lines.

Assess the capital implications of acquisitions, investments, dividends, growth initiatives, and strategic transactions.

Partner with Risk and Actuarial leadership on capital and solvency assessments.

7. Asset-Liability Management

Provide executive oversight of asset-liability management (ALM) across relevant insurance and investment businesses.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support balance-sheet optimization and financial stress-testing initiatives.

8. Treasury & Liquidity

Lead Group treasury, liquidity, cash management, and banking relationships.

Establish Group-wide liquidity policies and funding strategies.

Optimize cash across subsidiaries while maintaining appropriate regulatory and operational liquidity.

Oversee debt facilities, guarantees, intercompany funding, and treasury risk.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

9. Capital Raising & Financing

Lead Group-level financing and capital-raising initiatives.

Develop relationships with banks, institutional investors, private equity firms, development-finance institutions, debt providers, and capital-market participants.

Oversee debt issuance, refinancing, capital injections, and other funding strategies.

Optimize the Group's capital structure and cost of capital.

Ensure funding capacity supports strategic growth.

10. M&A, Investments & Corporate Development

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, disposals, strategic investments, and joint ventures.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and deal structuring.

Assess the impact of transactions on earnings, capital, solvency, liquidity, and shareholder value.

Partner with the CEO and Board on major strategic transactions.

Oversee financial integration and post-transaction performance.

11. Group Financial Reporting & Consolidation

Ensure accurate and timely consolidated financial reporting across the Group.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and Board reporting.

Establish consistent accounting and reporting standards across subsidiaries.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Maintain strong relationships with external auditors and professional advisers.

12. Regulatory & Governance

Maintain strong financial governance across the Group.

Ensure compliance with applicable insurance, investment, corporate, tax, and financial regulations.

Manage relationships with regulators, auditors, rating agencies, and other external stakeholders.

Establish effective internal controls and financial policies.

Ensure appropriate governance across subsidiaries, SPVs, joint ventures, and investment entities.

13. Financial Risk Management

Establish and oversee the Group's financial risk-management framework.

Monitor market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, investment, interest-rate, FX, and operational financial risks.

Establish appropriate stress-testing and contingency-planning processes.

Work closely with the Group CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and business leaders to manage enterprise-wide risk.

14. Tax Strategy

Oversee Group-wide tax planning, compliance, reporting, and risk management.

Ensure appropriate tax governance across subsidiaries and jurisdictions.

Identify opportunities for legitimate tax efficiency.

Monitor changes in tax and regulatory requirements affecting the Group.

15. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, lenders, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Lead financial communications to the Board and key investors.

Support investor presentations, annual reports, strategic reviews, and capital-market activities.

Clearly communicate the Group's financial strategy, performance, and outlook.

16. Finance Transformation

Modernize the Group's finance operating model, systems, processes, and reporting infrastructure.

Strengthen ERP, FP&A, consolidation, business intelligence, and financial analytics capabilities.

Drive automation and digital transformation across finance.

Improve transparency and real-time visibility across subsidiaries and business units.

17. Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead the Group Finance function and senior finance leadership across subsidiaries.

Develop a high-performing, commercially focused finance organization.

Establish common standards, talent-development programs, and succession plans.

Build strong relationships with subsidiary CFOs and Finance Directors.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and value creation.

Key Performance Indicators

The Group CFO will be accountable for:

Group revenue and earnings growth

Group EBITDA / net income performance

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Insurance underwriting profitability

Combined ratio / loss ratio performance

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow strength

Balance-sheet optimization

Cost of capital

Capital-raising effectiveness

M&A and strategic-investment performance

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and reporting compliance

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

18+ years of progressive finance experience, including substantial Group or enterprise-level leadership.

Previous experience as Group CFO, CFO, Deputy Group CFO, Group Finance Director, Finance Director, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, pensions, reinsurance, or diversified financial services.

Proven experience managing complex group structures, subsidiaries, investment entities, and regulated businesses.

Strong understanding of insurance financial reporting, capital and solvency requirements, investment portfolios, and balance-sheet management.

Demonstrated experience in capital allocation, treasury, liquidity, financial planning, and enterprise risk.

Experience working directly with Boards, CEOs, regulators, auditors, investors, lenders, and rating agencies.

Preferred Experience

Previous Group CFO experience within a diversified insurance or investment group.

Experience covering both insurance operations and investment/asset-management businesses.

Exposure to life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, pensions, or institutional investment.

Experience managing significant investment portfolios and ALM.

Proven experience with M&A, capital raising, restructuring, strategic investments, or international expansion.

Experience across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory environments.

Experience working with international institutional investors or rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is advantageous.

Additional insurance, investment, actuarial, or risk-management qualifications are desirable.

Core Competencies

Group Financial Leadership

Corporate Finance

Insurance Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Capital Allocation

M&A & Corporate Development

Regulatory Reporting

Risk Management

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Finance Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful Group CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially astute, and financially rigorous

Comfortable operating across complex group structures

Strong in capital allocation and investment decisions

Experienced in highly regulated environments

A sophisticated communicator at Board and investor level

Strong in balance-sheet and liquidity management

Comfortable challenging business leaders and driving accountability

Able to balance growth, profitability, capital, liquidity, and risk

An effective partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, Chief Actuary, and subsidiary CEOs

A transformational leader capable of building a world-class Group Finance function

Compensation

A competitive executive compensation package comprising base salary, performance-based incentives, executive benefits, and other benefits commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Medical Billing & Coding Specialist with strong hands-on experience supporting U.S. healthcare practices.

The ideal candidate will have at least 3 years of direct experience in U.S. healthcare billing and coding, preferably working within an actual medical practice or healthcare organization such as Primary Care, Behavioral Health, Mental Health, Dental, Ophthalmology, or another specialty practice.

This is a hands-on role for a professional who understands the U.S. healthcare revenue cycle and can independently manage billing, coding, claims, denials, Accounts Receivable (AR), and payer-related processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle day-to-day U.S. medical billing and coding activities.
  • Prepare, review, and submit accurate claims to Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance payers.
  • Review medical records and billing information to ensure accurate coding and claims submission.
  • Apply and interpret CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, and appropriate modifiers.
  • Identify and correct billing and coding errors that may result in claim rejections or denials.
  • Manage denials, rejected claims, appeals, and claim corrections.
  • Perform Accounts Receivable (AR) follow-up and resolve outstanding insurance balances.
  • Investigate unpaid, underpaid, and denied claims and follow up with insurance companies.
  • Support the complete Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) process.
  • Review EOBs and ERAs and reconcile payments against submitted claims.
  • Perform payment posting and identify discrepancies where applicable.
  • Verify and maintain accurate patient and insurance information.
  • Work with payer portals, clearinghouses, EHR/EMR systems, and billing platforms.
  • Identify recurring billing and denial issues and recommend improvements.
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation.
  • Communicate professionally with insurance companies, healthcare providers, patients, and internal teams when required.
  • Follow client-specific billing, coding, compliance, and workflow requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on U.S. medical billing and coding experience.
  • Direct experience working within a U.S. healthcare practice, clinic, or healthcare organization.
  • Experience supporting one or more healthcare specialties, such as: Primary Care / Family Medicine, Behavioral Health, Mental Health, Dental, Ophthalmology, Specialty Care, & Other U.S. healthcare practice environments
  • Strong understanding of the U.S. healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) process.
  • Hands-on experience with: Medical Billing, Medical Coding, Claims Submission, Denial Management, Accounts Receivable (AR), Claim Follow-up, Payment Posting, Insurance Verification and/or Eligibility
  • Experience working with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance.
  • Strong understanding of CPT codes, with working knowledge of ICD-10, HCPCS, and modifiers.
  • Ability to review claims and identify billing or coding discrepancies.
  • Strong understanding of insurance payer processes and requirements.
  • Strong computer skills and ability to work with healthcare software, EHRs/EMRs, clearinghouses, and payer portals.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working directly within a specific U.S. healthcare practice or specialty.
  • Experience handling complex denials, appeals, and aging AR.
  • Experience with multiple insurance payer portals and clearinghouses.
  • Experience with healthcare EHR/EMR and practice management systems.
  • Medical billing or coding certification such as CPC, CCS, CPB, CCA, or equivalent.

Certification is not required, but a relevant medical billing or coding certification is considered a plus.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a senior-level, hands-on professional, not someone whose experience is limited to general healthcare administration.

The ideal candidate should be able to demonstrate practical experience managing the U.S. medical billing and coding process, including CPT coding, claims submission, payer follow-up, denials, AR, and RCM.

Candidates with direct experience working inside a medical practice or healthcare organization are strongly preferred.

Application Requirements

When applying, please ensure your CV clearly highlights:

  1. Your 3+ years of U.S. medical billing and coding experience.
  2. The specific healthcare practice(s) or specialties you have supported.
  3. Your experience with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance.
  4. Your hands-on experience with CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, and modifiers.
  5. Your experience with RCM, denials, AR, claims, and payment posting.
  6. The EHR/EMR, billing systems, clearinghouses, and payer portals you have used.
  7. Any relevant medical billing or coding certifications.

Please note: Candidates whose experience is primarily general healthcare administration, without hands-on U.S. medical billing and coding experience, may not be considered.

jobs.description:
ABOUT VICTORY LIVE
Victory Live is a private equity backed technology company aimed at maximizing distribution and yield for live event ticket inventory. We provide an end-to-end software platform for the live ticketing industry, managing thousands of sports, theater, and live music event tickets on behalf of artists, promoters, teams, venues, and professional resellers. Victory Live’s comprehensive offerings include an established B2B marketplace, along with both a full-service and an automated SaaS platform to handle all elements of the ticket sales lifecycle, from ingestion to sales fulfillment.

THE POSITION
The Sr. Software Engineer on our C# and .NET services is the engine room of our engineering org. You will lead projects from planning through execution, write the code on the hardest pieces, and raise the bar for the engineers around you. You'll also be a force multiplier for AI-assisted development on your team, modeling how to use Claude, Copilot, and agentic workflows to ship faster without compromising quality.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead delivery of more in-depth initiatives from planning through launch in partnership with product and technical leadership, where you own the technical execution.
  • Take on the hard parts. When a .NET service needs a rewrite or a hard data migration, you're the one writing it.
  • Shape architecture. Participate actively in design discussions on our C# services, write design docs, and weigh tradeoffs out loud so the team can learn from your reasoning.
  • Mentor mid-level and junior engineers. Pair, code-review thoughtfully, and help teammates level up their skills, including their AI tooling fluency.
  • Drive process improvements. Spot recurring pain in the team's workflow and propose changes, not just complaints.
  • Push the AI-native bar. Build internal tooling, prompt patterns, and agentic workflows that make the whole team faster, not just yourself.
  • Be a reliable code reviewer on PRs across the team, including outside your immediate project area.
  • Operate cleanly on-call. Know your services in production; lead incident response when needed and write the postmortem.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years building production software, with strong depth in C# and .NET.
  • Demonstrated ability to make sound architectural decisions in a .NET service and explain tradeoffs clearly in writing.
  • Strong technical depth in backend systems, API design, or distributed services built on .NET.
  • Mentorship experience and a track record of helping teammates grow.
  • Fluent, deliberate use of AI tooling across the full engineering lifecycle (design, code, test, debug, review, docs).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with RabbitMQ or Kafka, Entity Framework Core at scale, and Azure or AWS cloud services.
  • Experience leading projects in marketplace, ticketing, e-commerce, or two-sided platform environments.
  • Comfort with Datadog, Grafana, Kibana, Airbrake, Sentry, OpsGenie, or comparable production tooling.

WHY VICTORY LIVE

  • You'll build the infrastructure live events run on; millions of tickets, hundreds of venues, many of the largest teams and events in the world.
  • A lean team where decisions move fast and your code reaches real fans, often the same week.
  • Every release has stakes. Every improvement is felt.
  • High expectations, low tolerance for politics, and a culture built on writing well and shipping with care.

OUR VALUES
We build the systems that power live event ticketing, and we hold a high bar for how we do it. Four principles run through everything:

  • Quality of life. Sustainable processes over heroics. Nobody should be a single point of failure, and nobody should be afraid to take a vacation.
  • Quality of code. Clarity over cleverness. If a teammate needs a long explanation to follow your code, it needs simplifying. Tests prove your work; they aren't optional.
  • Protection of production. Every change is reviewed, tested, and observable. We build with monitoring in mind from day one so we find problems before our users do.
  • Shared knowledge. We work across time zones, so we communicate in the open. Questions go in channels, not DMs, and one answer becomes shared knowledge.

ENGINEERING PRINCIPLES
We are an AI-native engineering team. Here is what that looks like in practice:

  • AI-assisted engineering. Every engineer uses Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, and agentic tooling as a routine part of their workflow.
  • Async-first. Most decisions happen in writing through Jira, Confluence, PR descriptions, design docs. We over-communicate on changes and under-communicate on noise.
  • Ownership mindset. Engineers are responsible for what they write and no code reaches production without review. Reviewers are co-owners.
  • Observability is part of "done." If the on-call engineer can't understand a system without reading source, more logging, metrics, and dashboards are needed.
  • Preservation of quality of code and life. We write code that is clean, tested, and maintainable so it serves us well over time, and we build sustainable processes so no one burns out or becomes a single point of failure.
  • Shared knowledge and continued education. We grow as a team by learning from each other through reviews, documentation, and collaboration.

OUR STACK & WAYS OF WORKING

  • C# and .NET power our B2B marketplace, distribution integrations, and partner-facing APIs
  • Web & mobile clients, REST APIs, microservices
  • Frameworks and tools: .NET, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, xUnit
  • Data: MSSQL Server, Postgres, Redis
  • Cloud & infra: Azure, AWS, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
  • AI tooling: Anthropic / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, in-house agentic workflows
  • Observability: Datadog, Grafana, Elastic/Kibana, OpsGenie
  • Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Slack, Miro
  • Async-first, agile cadences, distributed onshore + offshore teams

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Comprehensive medical coverage
  • 100% employer-paid dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid time off and company holidays
  • Employee wellness and professional development opportunities

Victory Live is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, Veteran status, or another other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law.

    hours/week and are available ~48 weeks per year to work those hours

  • You have read our company values, and are aligned with them

About you:

We’re looking for a Grunt who:

  • Loves making customers happy. You're on a mission to making customers happy and successful. You're eager to leverage your talents to meet their needs.

  • Loves to learn. You're excited to learn new skills, and looking to be at the forefront of Engineering and DevOps best practices.

  • Loves a challenge. You like to perform at your best by aiming high while also taking care of yourself and those around you.

  • Cares about your fellow humans. You look to make personal connections with the people you work with, and you want to work for a company whose mission and people you believe in.

  • Has extensive experience with building infrastructure. You have worked for years with cloud technologies, have deep familiarity with building cloud infrastructure and security best practices.

One of our values is that work-life balance leads to both better work and a better life, so we require that all our team members live in a time zone between Los Angeles and New York, inclusive. You can be located anywhere in the western hemisphere, though most of our team is in the USA and Canada.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist Job
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are At Murmuration, we believe that America’s promise is shaped and reshaped by the best ideas and ideals of its communities, and the dreams of the people who believe in a better life for themselves, their families, and each other.
jobs.description:
Who We Are
At Murmuration, we believe that America’s promise is shaped and reshaped by the best ideas and ideals of its communities, and the dreams of the people who believe in a better life for themselves, their families, and each other.

We help organizations build power in their communities in four key ways: we organize a network of values-aligned partners; we provide deep, data-driven insights into people, places, and perspectives; we develop tools that make organizing and engagement easy and more effective; and we offer services that strengthen our partners’ capacity to lead change in their communities.

We envision an America where every community has what it needs to help people lead healthy, free, and dignified lives. We work to redesign the systems and structures we all depend on — how we learn, live, govern, and solve problems — so that they are just, equitable, resilient, and rooted in shared responsibility. By strengthening the ties that hold communities together, we aim for civic life defined by collective action and care, with effective leadership that truly represents everyone.

We are a collaborative, curious, and creative team of organizers, scientists, teachers, technologists, campaign veterans, and more who share the unwavering belief that we can use our gifts in service of transforming America — together. We’ve built our team guided by the belief that the whole is greater than the sum of its parts. And so we support each other relentlessly — rallying together to face challenges the same way we celebrate each other’s wins.

About the Position

As a Senior Data Scientist at Murmuration, you’ll practice “full-stack” data science, shepherding problems from ideation to implementation. The Data Science team works on diverse datasets with hundreds of millions of records to analyze data, build pipelines, and derive insights to power Murmuration’s data and tools. A core part of this work is our predictive stack: we use the voter file and other supplemental datasets to build scores that predict individual behaviors and beliefs, such as likelihood to turn out to vote, support an issue, or volunteer on a campaign. These scores help campaigns and organizers allocate their resources more effectively, reaching the right people at the right time. In this role, you will help drive this work forward, developing innovative methodologies with a focus on campaign data models and entity resolution. As a senior member of the team, you’ll mentor developing data scientists and junior analysts and collaborate closely with the engineering, product, and research teams.

Job Level P4

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and execute data science projects, including predictive modeling, algorithm design, and data pipelines;
  • Develop innovative, industry-leading campaign data science models, specifically partisanship and turnout models;
  • Independently (and often collaboratively) explore data sets for insights and understanding what can help drive product development and feature prioritization;
  • Transform data into actionable and compelling insights through analysis and visualization, and then effectively communicate these data-driven stories to internal and external stakeholders through memos and presentations;
  • Collaborate with the Engineering Team to take data science products and concepts into production;
  • Provide guidance and mentoring to level-up junior data scientists in both formal and informal learning sessions; and
  • Apply emerging AI technologies to R&D challenges; you’ll prototype novel approaches, evaluate feasibility, and bridge the gap between cutting-edge capabilities and practical usability.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of work experience as a Data Scientist or equivalent role producing models and analytics for business applications;
  • Deep understanding of advanced data science techniques, machine learning algorithms, and optimization methods;
  • Experience building and deploying machine learning models;
  • Proficiency in data engineering and data pipelines;
  • Skill in using advanced data visualization tools and techniques to effectively communicate insights and tell compelling stories with data;
  • Mastery of programming languages (Python and SQL), version control (Git), and ability to learn and apply new data science tools and techniques efficiently;
  • Exceptional problem-solving abilities, strong leadership skills, and ability to communicate insights strategically to influence team direction;
  • Ability to mentor and guide junior team members in their technical growth and development; and
  • Capacity to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

Nice to Haves

  • Domain expertise in organizing and advocacy;
  • Experience working with voter file data and in campaign data science;
  • Familiarity with data engineering tools such as dbt and Dagster;
  • Experience with polling methodologies, survey analysis, and multilevel regression and poststratification (MRP) modeling; and/or
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

Talented Data Scientists come from all walks of life and career. If you are passionate about civic engagement and technology, please apply, even if you do not check every box!

Benefits

Location and Compensation

The Senior Data Scientist is a full-time, salaried position with a comprehensive benefits package (detail below), open to candidates anywhere in the United States.

The starting salary for this position is $183,013. We set compensation using market data and apply it consistently across the organization to ensure fairness and transparency for everyone in similar roles.

Our Culture of Care

We work hard to create a culture of care to ensure that our staff are best equipped to lead happy, healthy, and balanced lives. To that end, we offer a comprehensive benefits package which includes:

  • Health, vision, and dental insurance with 100% of premiums covered for you and qualifying family members;
  • Retirement benefits with a 5% employer match;
  • A flexible unlimited PTO plan;
  • Generous paid parental leave;
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits;
  • A company laptop;
  • A flexible remote work environment;
  • A home office setup stipend for all new employees;
  • Monthly reimbursement for remote work expenses;
  • A yearly professional development fund;
  • Mental health and wellness benefits through Calm and Better Help;
  • Yearly in-person staff retreats; and
  • A welcoming culture that celebrates diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging.

At Murmuration, we believe a vibrant, representative democracy depends on the inclusion of diverse voices, lived experiences, and perspectives. The best ideas don’t come from a single person or ideology — they emerge at the intersection of different backgrounds, identities, and viewpoints. We are proud of our commitment to building an organization and culture shaped by respect, empathy, and collaboration, where our team’s diversity fuels innovation, civic engagement, and meaningful change. We welcome new colleagues who will help us nurture this collective effort. Join us.

An Equal-Opportunity Employer with a Commitment to Diversity

Murmuration is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and as an organization committed to diversity and the perspective of all voices, we consider applicants equally of race, gender, color, sexual orientation, religion, marital status, disability, political affiliation and national origin. We reasonably accommodate staff members and/or applicants with disabilities, provided they are otherwise able to perform the essential functions of the job.

Note: Murmuration is two organizations working together to pursue our mission of amplifying the power of civic engagement: Murmuration Research Institute, a 501(c)(3) that conducts research to identify, design, and create the data, tools, and insights that build healthier and more equitable communities; and Murmuration, Inc., a 501(c)(4) that supports organizations working across the country on the nation’s most challenging issues with access to data, tools, and research that build healthier and more equitable communities.

Our team of CFP® professionals are at the core of our service and are empowered by our best-in-class support teams and proprietary technology platform. This model allows Facet to integrate advice into our members’ entire financial picture—all for an affordable, flat membership fee.

Our commitment to innovation and member success has earned national recognition, including being ranked the #1 Best Financial Advisory Firm 2025 by USA TODAY and named to Newsweek’s list of America’s Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025. With an A+ BBB Rating and a Trustpilot “Excellent” score (as of Sept. 16, 2025)*, we are proud to be redefining the industry for our members and our team alike.

Why Facet? The Future of Financial Planning Leadership

The Senior Director of Planners role at Facet is a high-impact, "leader of leaders" role designed for someone who is passionate about redefining the human impact of financial advice. We have moved past the traditional silos of wealth management to build a workforce that turns financial data into life-changing guidance. In this role, you aren’t just managing a department; you are leading a community of growth-seekers empowered by technology to do what only humans can: connect, coach, and catalyze real life change. By upleveling our leadership layer, you will empower every planner on the team to execute our Evolved Planner playbook with elite quality, deep consistency, and true human impact at scale.

What Makes This Role Different?

  • Scale Life Change, Not Products: Your primary mission is to ensure every member receives objective, life-changing advice. You are the leader of a model that prioritizes "service with soul," empowering our planners to understand a member's unique psychology and money stories to drive real behavior change.
  • Focus on the Member, Not the Paperwork: We’ve built a proprietary, tech-enabled ecosystem to take the administrative burden off our planners' plates. As a leader, you ensure this synergy allows our team to move beyond transactional tasks and step into elevated roles as inspiring guides and thought partners.
  • Leadership of Technology-Fluent Professionals: You will lead the organization through the transition from tech proficiency to AI fluency. You focus your energy on coaching our teams to work hand-in-hand with our systems, unlocking the human "superpower" of empathy and connection that technology cannot replicate.
  • Join a Movement: We operate with a "One Facet" mentality—a flat, non-hierarchical structure that eliminates silos. You aren’t just managing a department; you’re leading a community of growth-seekers redefining an underserved industry and saving the world for families.

Your Impact & Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Leadership & Capacity Management: Manage and scale the Planning Leadership Team, coaching them to be world-class developers of talent who master the human elements of advice. You will oversee the strategic health and capacity of the entire organization, ensuring we balance workforce demand with an elite member experience to drive sustainable growth.
  • Deputy to the VP of Planning & Member Experience: Serve as the VP’s operational proxy, leading the management layer independently and making high-stakes tactical decisions.
  • Driving Scale & Performance:. Own the delivery of core metrics – pod NPS, planner capacity, and member action on advice – across a large, scaling workforce, ensuring high volume never dilutes quality.
  • Champion of Human / Technology Synergy: Lead the organization through the adoption of new technology, ensuring planners retool their skills to act as connectors to our team of experts and products.
  • Metric Consistency: Drive functional alignment to ensure all members have a high quality experience at every touchpoint.
  • Strategic Communication: Translate complex business strategies into an inspiring "why" that drives organizational action and talent growth.

Who You Are:

  • A Leader of Leaders: You have deep experience coaching other managers to be better leaders. You know how to build a high-performing leadership bench that takes true ownership of their results.
  • A Proven Scale Driver: You have explicitly done this before. You have successfully led a large team (50+) through a major structural and/or operational evolution while maintaining peak team performance and high morale.
  • An Emotional Architect: You possess elite skills in coaching and can help planners navigate the human elements that technology cannot replicate.
  • A Tech Champion & AI Fluent: You fully embrace AI-driven tools to enhance efficiency and can guide a large workforce through the transition to tech-integrated planning.
  • Adaptable, Organized & Innovative: You are highly process-oriented but flexible enough to navigate rapid changes. You know how to build the structured frameworks and feedback loops needed to turn complex, high-level business transitions into smooth, organized daily operations.
  • A Trusted Leader through Change: You possess high empathy and excellent communication skills. You understand that change is hard for people, and know how to build deep trust, handle pushback, and bring hesitant teams along with you.
  • An Unshakeable Cultural Anchor: You bring contagious high energy, optimism, and relentless positivity to the team. You are a highly resilient leader who thrives under pressure and serves as a stabilizing force that keeps the team focused, motivated, and execution-oriented during rapid growth.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of "manager of managers" experience
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, communication, emotional intelligence, and complex problem solving skills

jobs.description:
Job Title: Technical Curriculum Developer - AI Agents

Job Location: Raleigh, NC, US

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

This is not a traditional curriculum developer role - please do not apply if you have dabbled with AI agents. In this unique role, we are accepting applications for two different personas:
    • The AI Solutions Engineer turned Mentor/Coach - you have an engineering/development background and have become the AI/Technical Trainer to teach learners how AI agents to build and configure agents and AI best practices.
    • The Technical Curriculum Developer turned AI Builder - you have a passion for teaching others deep technical topics, and have the curiosity and drive to learn and vibe code agentic solutions/integrations.
If you are one of these profiles and have proven, demonstrable experience - please apply now!
You'll build the training that teaches customers, partners and Veevans how to use, configure, and implement and integrate our platform — including its Agentic AI capabilities — and you'll build the AI agents that power our demos and hands-on labs.
You should be able to walk into an unfamiliar product area, understand its architecture and APIs, and within days be building working agent demos and lab exercises around it.
You'll also own and evolve our most technical training courses, the coding-intensive classes that require real Java and REST API fluency, bringing rigor and firsthand credibility that generalist curriculum developers can't.

What You'll Do

AI Agent Curriculum & Enablement

    • Design and build hands-on training and lab environments that teach technical learners how to build, configure, and deploy custom AI agents on our platform
    • Build working AI agent demos and reference implementations from scratch to anchor training content and live demonstrations
    • Translate the practical challenges learners face when configuring or implementing Agentic AI — tool/function calling, context management, prompt design, error handling, guardrails, orchestration — into clear, sequenced learning experiences
    • Stay current with the agentic AI landscape (frameworks, MCP-style tool integrations, agent orchestration patterns)

Technical Curriculum Development

    • Own and maintain our advanced technical courses, including classes that require coding in Java and working with REST APIs
    • Build and maintain hands-on lab environments, sample code, sandbox data, and technical exercises that mirror real implementation scenarios
    • Partner with Product and Engineering to get early access to new features and build courseware alongside General release
    • Apply instructional design best practices (learning objectives, scaffolding, assessment design, adult learning principles) to technical content without watering down technical accuracy

Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Work closely with Product Management and Engineering to understand agent architecture, APIs, and configuration options as they're being built
    • Partner with Professional Services, Managed Services and Customer Support to identify pain points and close those gaps with curriculum

Requirements

    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Instructional Design, or equivalent practical experience
    • Hands-on experience building, configuring, and deploying AI agents (e.g., using frameworks/SDKs such as LangChain, LangGraph, Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK/Claude Code, or similar)
    • Practical understanding of core agent concepts: tool/function calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), context/memory management, multi-agent orchestration, prompt engineering, and evaluation
    • Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable tool-integration standards is a strong plus
    • First-hand experience troubleshooting the real problems agent builders hit — flaky tool calls, context overflow, hallucinated actions, permission/scoping issues — so you can teach learners to anticipate and solve them, not just follow a script
    • Ability to read and understand Java code architecture and classes for minor development or debugging, alongside a strong foundational knowledge of REST APIs
    • Experience with Git, Postman, or similar API tooling
    • 3+ years building technical training, curriculum, or enablement content for a technical audience (developers, implementation consultants, technical admins, or power users)
    • Experience designing hands-on labs, sandbox exercises, and high quality instructor-led courses and/or eLearning
    • Familiarity with LMS platforms and AI/authoring tools (e.g., Articulate, Camtasia, Arcade, Vyond, Gemini, Claude or similar) is a plus
    • Experience with Veeva Vault, or ability to quickly ramp up on, complex enterprise SaaS platforms — including how Veeva Vault is configured and implemented by customers
    • Self-directed and comfortable with ambiguity — this role will often be defining the curriculum for capabilities that are still being built
    • Strong writing and technical communication skills; able to explain complex technical concepts clearly to varied audiences (technical and semi-technical learners)
    • Strong presentation and facilitation skills; comfortable leading live demos and workshops

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $100,000 - $175,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We are looking for an experienced QA Automation Engineer to join TXP and work as part of an agile engineering team delivering high-quality, mission-critical digital solutions.

You will contribute across functional and non-functional testing, developing and maintaining automated test solutions while supporting a strong shift-left quality culture across the engineering team.

WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING:

As part of an agile software development team, you will:

  • Develop, enhance and maintain robust automated test solutions and frameworks.
  • Perform detailed test analysis and test design for complex and highly integrated systems.
  • Create and execute automated tests across different levels of the application.
  • Apply modern testing approaches including TDD, BDD and risk-based testing.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Promote shift-left testing and quality engineering best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Perform testing across Unit, Component, Integration, System and End-to-End levels.
  • Support functional and non-functional testing activities.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Business Acceptance Testing (BAT) where required.
  • Manage test data, testing documentation and associated QA artefacts.
  • Work closely with developers, including participating in pair-programming activities where appropriate.
  • Identify, investigate and support the resolution of defects.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing processes and automation practices.
  • Mentor and support less experienced testing colleagues.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

  • Strong commercial experience in QA/Test Automation.
  • Hands-on experience designing, developing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Broad understanding of software testing across both functional and non-functional testing.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and Continuous Integration practices.
  • Experience working within Agile/iterative software development environments.
  • Experience testing complex and integrated enterprise applications.
  • Good understanding of test design, test analysis and risk-based testing.
  • Experience using Git and GitLab.
  • Ability to work closely with developers and other engineering disciplines.
  • Strong attention to detail and a quality-first mindset.
  • Ability to manage priorities and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English

TECHNICAL ENVIRONMENT:

You will be working with technologies and concepts including:

  • Playwright
  • Selenium
  • Cucumber
  • Postman
  • JUnit
  • Gatling
  • OWASP ZAP
  • Git / GitLab
  • Docker / Kubernetes
  • Azure and/or AWS
  • API testing
  • Performance testing
  • Accessibility testing, including WCAG, WAVE or Axe

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience working within complex, enterprise-scale or regulated environments.
  • Exposure to performance and security/penetration testing.
  • Experience implementing or improving automation frameworks.
  • Knowledge of accessibility testing standards.
  • Experience coaching or mentoring other QA/Test Engineers.
  • Formal education in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, although equivalent professional experience is equally valued.

  • Be part of our collegial environment where responsibility and authority are shared equally amongst colleagues and help create our company culture.

  • An Agile environment where your ideas are welcome
  • The possibility to grow and experience different projects
  • Ongoing Training & Mentoring

On behalf of NDA, Healthcare Support, SD Solutions is looking for a compassionate and dedicated Patient Advocate to help patients navigate the complexities of the healthcare system.

SD Solutions is a staffing company operating globally. Contact us to get more details about the benefits we offer.

Responsibilities include informing patients of their financial options, responding to patient and client queries, enrolling qualified patients into financial assistance programs, and coordinating the delivery of free medications and assistance payments. To be a successful Patient Advocate, you should be highly empathetic, passionate about the well-being of patients, be driven to achieve set goals, and have a desire to learn more about the healthcare field.

Responsibilities:

  • Enroll patients in philanthropic aid programs.
  • Effectively manage post-enrollment work such as submitting claims or ordering medications.
  • Reviewing patient enrollments for accuracy and completeness.
  • Escalate and appeal patient assistance denials.
  • Order, receive, and log medication orders.
  • Coordinate medication deliveries to the designated pharmacy timely.
  • Always provide exceptional customer service to both the patient and client.
  • Provide patients with information they need to make informed financial decisions about their healthcare.
  • Identify opportunities to improve Atlas products and services.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in a high-performance, high accountability environment.
  • Hands-on experience working in healthcare is a must.
  • High-school diploma or equivalent.
  • Strong listening and communication skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proficient computer skills.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Ability to offer emotional support and empathy.
  • Have passion for the well-being of patients.
  • Pass standard background check and drug screen.
  • Complete medical clearance per health system requirements (includes vaccination mandates).
  • Remote positions require a distraction free office environment that is HIPAA compliant where Atlas is professionally represented.

Internet Service Requirements:

  • Internet access provided by a cable or fiber provider
  • DSL, satellite, and wireless broadband is NOT permitted; however, in an emergency, if there is an internet outage, your mobile hot spot can be used.
  • Minimum upload speed of 2 mbps.
  • Minimum download speed of 5 mbps.
  • Maintaining an uninterrupted internet connection is a requirement of the Work From Home position. You may be asked to upgrade your existing service or switch providers to meet the job requirements.

Modem & Router Requirements:

Our technology department has determined that modem/router combinations (sometimes referred to as a multi-port modem or gateway) often cause connection problems with company issued phones that can prevent connection. You may need to add a router into your network that meets the following guidelines:

  • Ethernet ports wired for gigabit speed connections
  • Availability of at least two (2) Ethernet connections to the internet source is required (for your PC and phone).
  • Your modem or router must either be in the same room as your workspace, or you must have an Ethernet cord long enough to reach your workspace to meet this requirement. Working wirelessly is prohibited.

About the company:

NDA, Healthcare Support is dedicated to helping patients navigate the complexities of the healthcare system with ease and confidence. Our mission is to connect individuals with the financial assistance programs and resources they need to access essential medical care. By combining compassionate support with efficient processes, we ensure that patients receive the medications and services they require without unnecessary stress.

Our team works closely with healthcare providers, pharmacies, and financial aid programs to streamline assistance and improve patient outcomes. With a commitment to excellence and patient advocacy, we strive to make healthcare more accessible for everyone.

By applying for this position, you agree to the terms outlined in our Privacy Policy. Please take a moment to review our Privacy Policy , and make sure you understand its contents. If you have any questions or concerns regarding our Privacy Policy, please feel free to contact us.

jobs.title: Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking
jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryThe Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking is responsible for establishing and leading the enterprise-wide risk management framework for the retail banking business.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking is responsible for establishing and leading the enterprise-wide risk management framework for the retail banking business. The CRO oversees credit, operational, market, liquidity, compliance, fraud, cyber, conduct, and reputational risks while ensuring alignment with the bank's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite.

The role provides independent oversight and challenge to business activities, safeguarding the institution's financial stability, customers, and reputation while enabling sustainable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain the retail banking risk management framework.
  • Establish risk appetite statements, risk limits, and governance standards.
  • Ensure effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of risks.
  • Provide independent oversight of business decisions and strategic initiatives.
  • Promote a strong risk culture throughout the organization.

Credit Risk Management

  • Oversee retail credit portfolios, including:
    • Mortgages
    • Personal Loans
    • Credit Cards
    • Auto Loans
    • Consumer Finance Products
  • Establish underwriting standards and credit policies.
  • Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency trends, and loss performance.
  • Lead stress testing and credit risk scenario analyses.
  • Recommend risk-adjusted lending strategies.

Operational Risk Management

  • Develop frameworks to identify and manage operational risks.
  • Monitor operational incidents, control failures, and emerging risks.
  • Oversee business continuity and operational resilience programs.
  • Strengthen internal controls and risk reporting mechanisms.
  • Ensure effective risk and control self-assessment processes.

Regulatory Compliance & Conduct Risk

  • Ensure compliance with banking regulations and consumer protection laws.
  • Oversee conduct risk management and fair customer treatment initiatives.
  • Maintain strong relationships with regulatory authorities.
  • Lead regulatory examinations and risk-related audits.
  • Ensure implementation of regulatory changes and risk controls.

Fraud & Financial Crime Risk

  • Oversee fraud prevention, detection, and investigation programs.
  • Strengthen anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-terrorist financing controls.
  • Monitor financial crime risks and emerging threats.
  • Ensure effective transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Collaborate with law enforcement and regulatory agencies when necessary.

Market & Liquidity Risk Oversight

  • Monitor interest rate risk and liquidity risk exposures.
  • Evaluate balance sheet vulnerabilities and stress scenarios.
  • Support asset-liability management activities.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory capital and liquidity requirements.

Cybersecurity & Technology Risk

  • Oversee technology and cyber risk governance.
  • Assess cybersecurity threats and resilience capabilities.
  • Ensure robust controls for digital banking platforms.
  • Monitor third-party and vendor risk exposures.
  • Support digital transformation initiatives through effective risk management.

Governance & Reporting

  • Present risk reports to Executive Management, Risk Committees, and the Board.
  • Develop key risk indicators (KRIs) and risk dashboards.
  • Ensure timely escalation of significant risk issues.
  • Maintain effective risk governance structures and committee frameworks.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead risk management teams across multiple disciplines.
  • Develop future risk leaders and succession plans.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, integrity, and transparency.
  • Promote collaboration across business, compliance, audit, and technology functions.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, Risk Management, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree (MBA, Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field) preferred.

Professional Certifications

Preferred certifications include:

  • Financial Risk Manager (FRM)
  • Professional Risk Manager (PRM)
  • Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)
  • Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS)

Experience

  • 15+ years of progressive banking and risk management experience.
  • Extensive experience within retail banking risk management.
  • Proven leadership experience overseeing enterprise risk functions.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, boards, and executive committees.
  • Strong understanding of consumer lending, deposits, payments, and digital banking.
  • Experience leading large, multidisciplinary risk teams.

Technical Competencies

  • Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
  • Retail Credit Risk
  • Operational Risk
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Financial Crime Risk
  • Fraud Risk Management
  • AML/KYC Frameworks
  • Market Risk
  • Liquidity Risk
  • Capital Adequacy Management
  • Cybersecurity Risk
  • Operational Resilience
  • Stress Testing
  • Risk Analytics & Modeling
  • Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Leadership
  • Risk-Based Decision Making
  • Executive Communication
  • Board & Regulatory Engagement
  • Crisis Management
  • Ethical Leadership
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Change Leadership
  • Problem Solving
  • Team Development

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Credit Loss Ratio
  • Non-Performing Loan (NPL) Ratio
  • Portfolio Delinquency Rates
  • Operational Loss Events
  • Regulatory Findings and Remediation
  • Fraud Loss Reduction
  • AML Compliance Effectiveness
  • Cyber Risk Incident Metrics
  • Risk Appetite Compliance
  • Capital and Liquidity Adequacy
  • Audit and Regulatory Examination Outcomes

We add value by providing flexibility – the right person (or people) with the right expertise for the job, at the right price. And we do it with a planning process that makes sure clients “measure twice and cut once” ensuring

superior execution.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to handle confidential information.

jobs.title: Senior Production Engineering Manager
jobs.excerpt: Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
jobs.description:
Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

What you'd be doing in this role:

This Engineering Manager role leads Embedded, one of Production Engineering's two teams.

You'll lead a technically strong group of engineers, deliberately weighted toward senior talent, working simultaneously across several of Canva's most important production challenges. Right now, those engagements include safeguarding critical data, making software changes safer, building reliability and observability into a major platform rewrite, and building tooling and frameworks to allow services to increase resilience to overload scenarios.

Because Embedded works alongside teams outside your reporting line, the role depends as much on influence as authority. You'll need to earn the trust of engineering leaders quickly, help your engineers navigate different technical and organisational environments, and stay close enough to the work to challenge assumptions and shape important technical decisions.

Embedded is still new, so you won't be stepping into a finished playbook. You'll help decide which problems the team takes on, how engagements should work, what great looks like, and how we measure whether Production Engineering is having the impact we intended.

You'll also be responsible for creating an environment where experienced engineers can do their best work: setting direction, building psychological safety, giving direct coaching and helping senior engineers grow their technical and organisational influence.

Looking ahead, this role will help build:

  • Impact where it matters most: Focus Embedded on the production problems where it can make the biggest difference, build trust with engineering leaders so the team is brought in early, and make that impact visible through measurable outcomes.

  • A model that scales: Work out how Embedded can run more engagements without losing the technical bar, coaching quality or close partnerships that make the model effective.

  • Standards worth reusing: Turn lessons from individual engagements into engineering practices, patterns and capabilities that can benefit teams across Canva.

  • The next generation of leaders: Develop senior engineers and engagement leads who can coach others, lead increasingly complex work and multiply the team's impact.

You’re probably a match:

We'd love to hear from you if you fit one or more of these. You don't need to meet all of them, but the more the better and if you join the team, we're invested in helping you grow.

Experience:

  • Leading senior engineers: You've led highly experienced software engineers and technical leads through complex or ambiguous work, and know how to coach people operating with significant autonomy.

  • Production exposure: You've worked in software environments where reliability, scalability and production risk genuinely mattered.

  • Earned authority: You've built trust from a standing start, particularly in environments where influence mattered more than reporting lines.

  • Cross-org delivery: You've led significant technical initiatives spanning multiple teams or groups, from understanding the problem through to delivering an outcome.

  • Driving adoption: You've persuaded teams to change how they build or operate software, even when they were busy, skeptical or already had an established way of working.

  • Engineering leadership: You can communicate complex technical trade-offs to senior stakeholders while creating an environment where engineers can challenge ideas, learn, receive direct feedback and do their best work.

Technical knowledge:

  • CS fundamentals: A strong grounding in computer science fundamentals, including concurrency, multithreading and data structures.

  • Language depth: Enough depth in languages such as Go, Python, Java or C++ to engage meaningfully with designs, implementation choices and technical trade-offs.

  • Systems knowledge: Strong working knowledge of system internals, networking and cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP.

  • Systems thinking: Comfortable reasoning through ambiguous problems spanning multiple components, teams and constraints, with a strong understanding of system design, architecture and engineering patterns.

  • Reliability engineering: Familiarity with observability, capacity, failure modes and the operational characteristics of production systems.

  • Scale and criticality: Experience working in large-scale or high-criticality environments where reliability failures have meaningful consequences for users, systems or the business.

Nice to have:

  • SRE/PE management: Prior experience leading Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering or a closely related function

  • Infrastructure exposure: Experience with large-scale storage, CDN, networking or distributed infrastructure

  • Growing technical leaders: A history of developing senior engineers and technical leads who can coach others and take on increasingly complex work

  • Function-building: Experience helping define the identity, operating model or scope of a technical function while it was still taking shape

About the Group and Team:

Production Engineering sits within Canva's Reliability Platform subgroup, part of the wider Infra supergroup responsible for the foundations Canva's engineering teams build on, including compute, storage, networking, developer experience and reliability.

At more than 250 million monthly active users, Canva's hardest reliability problems increasingly span systems, teams and organisational boundaries. Production Engineering exists to help keep Canva reliable, efficient and predictable as that complexity grows.

It's primarily a software engineering function. Rather than operating systems from the sidelines or papering over problems with process, Production Engineers solve operational challenges through design and code.

The function is split into two teams: Embedded and Core.

Embedded works directly alongside teams across Canva on targeted, long-running engineering engagements. Engineers typically work in small groups, combining senior technical leadership with engineers who can learn from the engagement and help carry that knowledge forward.

Core owns Production Engineering services and works on broader problems that cut across multiple teams or groups. When an Embedded engagement uncovers an idea worth applying more widely, Embedded and Core can work together to turn that learning into reusable capability across Canva.

Embedded is deliberately weighted toward senior technical talent. Production Engineers need to enter unfamiliar problem spaces, understand complex systems quickly and earn credibility with the engineers who already own them.

Because the function is still taking shape, the team is also defining its own identity: where Production Engineering can have the greatest impact, how it partners with other teams, and how individual wins become lasting engineering capability across Canva.

What’s in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard — and we do — but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

  • Equity packages — we want our success to be yours too

  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers

  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more

  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and support you personally

Other stuff to know?

We see AI as a powerful amplifier of creativity and technology at Canva. We're evolving how we assess AI skills in our Technology hiring experience — you'll tackle interactive, real-time challenges that reflect the kind of work we do. In some interviews, you may also be asked to solve a problem using an AI tool to show how you approach challenges with tech by your side.

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture.

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva, so even if you don't feel like your skills quite match what's listed above — we still want to hear from you!

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

Data Researcher

Employment Type: Contract (Independent Contractor)
Department: Data Management

IMPORTANT TIPS:

  • Apply with Gmail (preferable). If you don’t, you will be asked to provide one before the training. We use Google Workspace and having Gmail is required for all researchers.

  • Do not submit more than one application for the same role. This is considered spamming and all your applications will be blocked.
  • Do not submit application on anyone’s behalf. This is considered fraud and you will be blacklisted indefinitely.

JOB DESCRIPTION & REQUIREMENTS:


About eCore

eCore was founded in 2020 to provide solutions that help companies address economic, competitive, and societal challenges while adapting workforce plans accordingly. We combine innovation, technology, and talent to simplify business processes and increase efficiency.

eCore is a rapidly growing company with a global mindset and a strong commitment to inclusive and respectful collaboration. We are a people-oriented organization that values motivated, well-managed, high-functioning teams.

About the position

We are seeking detail-oriented, computer-savvy individuals to support Korean-language data research projects. This is a 100% remote independent contractor role.

Contractors have the flexibility to determine how and when they complete assigned work, provided agreed project timelines and quality standards are met. Initial onboarding and project coordination support are provided to ensure alignment with project requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver completed lead generation outputs based on Korean-language online research
  • Provide accurate data entry, enrichment, and maintenance deliverables
  • Validate and cleanse datasets according to defined project specifications
  • Ensure research outputs meet documented quality and acceptance criteria

Qualifications:

  • Experience in lead generation, data research, data analysis, or data quality assurance.
  • Prior experience working remotely or in an online environment.
  • Fluent or near-native proficiency in Korean (written and spoken)
  • Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken)
  • Strong internet research skills with excellent attention to detail
  • Proficiency with productivity tools such as Google Docs, Google Sheets, Microsoft Office, and messaging platforms
  • Access to a computer with at least 8GB RAM and a reliable internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps download speed)

Contractor Notice

This role is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contractors are responsible for their own taxes, insurance, and legal compliance in their respective country of residence. Compensation is based on completed deliverables.

Why Join eCore?

  • Fully remote work
  • Flexibility to manage your own schedule
  • Clearly defined scopes and deliverables
  • Training and coordination support
  • Opportunity to contribute to global data projects

COUNTRIES WE ARE CURRENTLY HIRING FROM: Philippines.

Screening Stages:

  • Pre-qualification
  • Video Interview
  • Data Researcher Training
  • Final test (to qualify for the role)

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

How do I know this is not a scam?

  • We're here to connect companies with the global workforce online, and we will never ask you for money. We want to pay you for the work that you've done on our platform. For more information about the company, please visit our website and LinkedIn page:

How should I prepare myself before applying for the role?

  • Prepare a resume that highlights your updated educational background and work experience.
  • Prepare valid identification documents for verification purposes.
  • You need to have at least 10 Mbps download speed for an internet connection. When filling out the application, you’ll be asked to run a speed test on your computer (do not use your phone for the speed test).
  • 8GB computer RAM capacity. It's important that your computer can handle the applications we work with. Your application will be disqualified if your computer RAM and internet connection don't meet the requirements.
  • Make sure your name on the application, ID, and resume match. If we find discrepancies, your application will be disqualified.

Is it safe to submit my ID and personal information?

  • We use the Breezy portal for application tracking. It’s a secure platform that allows us to store and protect your personal information. Only authorized hiring team members have access to applications and attached documents.

What are the steps I need to take in order to get hired?

  1. Click the 'Apply To Position' button and complete the application form.
  2. After you submit all necessary information, you will receive an invite to record a video interview. You will be asked a few questions to help us get to know you better.
  3. The hiring team reviews applications and selects the best-fitting candidates to begin the training program.
  4. If you’re selected, you will receive an invite to start Data Researcher Training. You have 6 days to complete the training materials and 1 day for the final test.
  5. After you pass the Final Test, you will be asked to sign the paperwork.
  6. Once the paperwork is complete, we will verify the validity of your identity, signature, and the information you have provided. If everything looks good, you are officially hired, and the probation period starts.

Is the training paid?

  • No, pre-hire training is not paid. You get paid after you’re officially hired and assigned to a project.

How do I get paid?

  • We pay via Payoneer once a month. Payoneer is a financial services company (similar to PayPal) that provides online money transfer and digital payment services. It connects to your bank account for fast, easy transactions. Please note that Payoneer is not part of eCore Services, and all fees collected by Payoneer are solely determined by them.

I submitted my application, but haven’t received a response. What should I do?

  • We review applications on a first-come-first-serve basis. We try to be efficient and respond in a timely manner, but if we have a high influx of applicants, our response may be delayed. Nevertheless, your application will be reviewed, and you will be notified of the decision. If you don’t receive a decision within 2 months, feel free to reach out to request an update.
